import React, { useState, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react';
import { Modal } from '../components/Modal/Modal';
import { Checkbox } from '../components/Checkbox/Checkbox';
import { Button } from '../components/Button/Button';
import { MessageInfo } from '../components/MessageInfo/MessageInfo';
import { MessageBox } from '../components/MessageBox/MessageBox';
import { Tags } from '../components/Tags/Tags';
import { Tooltip } from '../components/Tooltip/Tooltip';
import { Info as InfoIcon } from '../foundations/icons/Icons';

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Meta
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const meta: Meta = {
  title: 'Design System/Patterns/Audit Log Duration',
  parameters: {
    layout: 'centered',
    docs: {
      description: {
        component:
          'Modal pattern for managing audit log retention settings — ' +
          'set visible log history and archived log retention durations ' +
          'using a dual-range slider.',
      },
    },
  },
};

export default meta;
type Story = StoryObj;

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Date helpers
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const MONTHS = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];

function subtractYears(date: Date, years: number): Date {
  const d = new Date(date);
  d.setFullYear(d.getFullYear() - years);
  return d;
}

function subtractDays(date: Date, days: number): Date {
  const d = new Date(date);
  d.setDate(d.getDate() - days);
  return d;
}

function fmtDate(d: Date): string {
  return `${MONTHS[d.getMonth()]} ${d.getDate()}, ${d.getFullYear()}`;
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Dual Range Slider
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function DualRangeSlider({
  min = 0,
  max = 10,
  maxA = max,
  valueA,
  valueB,
  onChangeA,
  onChangeB,
  showThumbB = true,
}: {
  min?: number;
  max?: number;
  maxA?: number;
  valueA: number;
  valueB: number;
  onChangeA: (v: number) => void;
  onChangeB: (v: number) => void;
  showThumbB?: boolean;
}) {
  const trackRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const steps    = Array.from({ length: max - min + 1 }, (_, i) => i + min);
  const count    = steps.length;

  const pctA = ((valueA - min) / (max - min)) * 100;
  const pctB = ((valueB - min) / (max - min)) * 100;

  const pickValue = useCallback((clientX: number) => {
    const rect  = trackRef.current!.getBoundingClientRect();
    const ratio = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (clientX - rect.left) / rect.width));
    return Math.round(min + ratio * (max - min));
  }, [min, max]);

  const startDrag = (thumb: 'a' | 'b') => (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const move = (ev: MouseEvent) => {
      const v = pickValue(ev.clientX);
      if (thumb === 'a') onChangeA(Math.min(Math.max(v, 1), Math.min(valueB - 1, maxA)));
      else               onChangeB(Math.max(v, valueA + 1, 2));
    };
    const up = () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousemove', move);
      document.removeEventListener('mouseup', up);
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousemove', move);
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', up);
  };

  const thumbStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
    position: 'absolute',
    width: 19, height: 19,
    top: '50%',
    transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
    borderRadius: '50%',
    background: '#fff',
    border: '2px solid #9C9CA6',
    boxShadow: '0 3px 12px rgba(49,57,73,0.15)',
    boxSizing: 'border-box',
    cursor: 'grab',
    outline: 'none',
    transition: 'left 80ms ease, border-color 120ms, box-shadow 120ms',
    zIndex: 1,
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ userSelect: 'none', width: '100%', fontFamily: 'var(--ds-font-family-base)' }}>
      <style>{`
        .ds-thumb-dot:hover {
          border-color: var(--ds-components-slider-active-bg-fill-color, #5464F2) !important;
        }
        .ds-thumb-dot:focus-visible {
          outline: 2px solid var(--ds-components-input-focus-outline, #5464F2);
          outline-offset: 2px;
          border-color: var(--ds-components-slider-active-bg-fill-color, #5464F2) !important;
        }
      `}</style>

      {/* ── Track + 2 thumbs ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <div ref={trackRef} style={{ position: 'relative', height: 16 }}>

        {/* Grey base track */}
        <div style={{
          position: 'absolute', left: 0, right: 0,
          top: '50%', transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
          height: 9, borderRadius: 4.5,
          background: 'var(--ds-components-slider-slider-bg-grey, #E5EAF2)',
          pointerEvents: 'none',
        }} />

        {/* Blue fill — visible range (left → thumb A) */}
        <div style={{
          position: 'absolute', left: 0, width: `${pctA}%`,
          top: '50%', transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
          height: 9, borderRadius: 4.5,
          background: 'var(--ds-components-slider-active-bg-fill-color, #5464F2)',
          pointerEvents: 'none',
        }} />

        {/* Orange fill — archive range (thumb A → thumb B) */}
        {showThumbB && pctB > pctA && (
          <div style={{
            position: 'absolute', left: `${pctA}%`, width: `${pctB - pctA}%`,
            top: '50%', transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
            height: 9, borderRadius: 4.5,
            background: 'var(--ds-icon-primary-orange, #F18E0A)',
            pointerEvents: 'none',
          }} />
        )}

        {/* Thumb A — visible end */}
        <div
          className="ds-thumb-dot"
          onMouseDown={startDrag('a')}
          style={{ ...thumbStyle, left: `${pctA}%` }}
          role="slider"
          tabIndex={0}
          aria-valuemin={min} aria-valuemax={valueB} aria-valuenow={valueA}
          aria-label="Visible log history end"
        />

        {/* Thumb B — archive end */}
        {showThumbB && (
          <div
            className="ds-thumb-dot"
            onMouseDown={startDrag('b')}
            style={{ ...thumbStyle, left: `${pctB}%`, zIndex: 2 }}
            role="slider"
            tabIndex={0}
            aria-valuemin={valueA} aria-valuemax={max} aria-valuenow={valueB}
            aria-label="Archive log end"
          />
        )}
      </div>

      {/* ── Numbers below — centered on each thumb's percentage position ──── */}
      <div style={{ position: 'relative', height: 14, marginTop: 6 }}>
        {steps.map((s, i) => {
          const pct = count > 1 ? (i / (count - 1)) * 100 : 50;
          return (
            <span key={s} style={{
              position: 'absolute',
              left: `${pct}%`,
              transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
              fontSize: 11,
              color: 'var(--ds-text-muted, #8B9BB8)',
              lineHeight: 1,
              whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
            }}>
              {s}
            </span>
          );
        })}
      </div>

    </div>
  );
}

function RetentionRow({
  dotColor,
  showDot = true,
  label,
  years,
  availableFrom,
  availableTo,
}: {
  dotColor: string;
  showDot?: boolean;
  label: string;
  years: number;
  availableFrom: string;
  availableTo: string;
}) {
  const text: React.CSSProperties = {
    fontFamily: 'var(--ds-font-family-base)',
    fontSize: 'var(--ds-font-size-base)',
    color: 'var(--ds-text-label)',
    lineHeight: '1.6',
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 1 }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 6 }}>
        {showDot && <div style={{
          width: 8, height: 8,
          borderRadius: '50%',
          background: dotColor,
          flexShrink: 0,
        }} />}
        <span style={{ ...text, color: 'var(--ds-text-base)', fontWeight: 'var(--ds-font-weight-semibold)' as any }}>
          {label}
        </span>
        <span style={{ ...text, color: 'var(--ds-text-base)' }}>
          : <strong style={{ fontWeight: 'var(--ds-font-weight-semibold)' as any }}>
            {years} {years === 1 ? 'year' : 'years'}
          </strong>
        </span>
      </div>
      <span style={{ ...text, paddingLeft: showDot ? 14 : 0 }}>
        Available Data:{' '}
        <span style={{ color: 'var(--ds-text-base)' }}>{availableFrom} - {availableTo}</span>
      </span>
      <span style={{ ...text, paddingLeft: showDot ? 14 : 0 }}>
        Estimated Data Storage:{' '}
        <span style={{ color: 'var(--ds-text-base)' }}>~ 0</span>
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}

const menuItemStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  display: 'block',
  width: '100%',
  padding: '10px 16px',
  textAlign: 'left',
  background: 'none',
  border: 'none',
  cursor: 'pointer',
  fontFamily: 'var(--ds-font-family-base)',
  fontSize: 'var(--ds-font-size-base)',
  color: 'var(--ds-text-base)',
  whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
};

function MoreMenu({ onManageRetention }: { onManageRetention: () => void }) {
  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useCallback(() => {}, []); // keep hook order stable

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!menuOpen) return;
    const close = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(e.target as Node)) setMenuOpen(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', close);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', close);
  }, [menuOpen]);

  return (
    <div ref={ref} style={{ position: 'relative', display: 'inline-block' }}>
      <button
        onClick={() => setMenuOpen(o => !o)}
        style={{
          display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
          width: 36, height: 36,
          border: '1px solid var(--ds-border-default, #D8DFF0)',
          borderRadius: 6,
          background: '#fff',
          cursor: 'pointer',
          fontSize: 20,
          letterSpacing: 1,
          color: 'var(--ds-text-base)',
          lineHeight: 1,
        }}
        aria-label="More options"
        aria-haspopup="true"
        aria-expanded={menuOpen}
      >
        ···
      </button>

      {menuOpen && (
        <div style={{
          position: 'absolute',
          top: 'calc(100% + 4px)',
          right: 0,
          background: '#fff',
          border: '1px solid var(--ds-border-default, #E2E8F5)',
          borderRadius: 8,
          boxShadow: '0 4px 16px rgba(49,57,73,0.14)',
          minWidth: 220,
          zIndex: 200,
          overflow: 'hidden',
        }}>
          <button
            style={menuItemStyle}
            onMouseEnter={e => (e.currentTarget.style.background = 'var(--ds-bg-surface-hover, #F5F7FA)')}
            onMouseLeave={e => (e.currentTarget.style.background = 'none')}
            onClick={() => { onManageRetention(); setMenuOpen(false); }}
          >
            Manage Log Retention Settings
          </button>
          <button
            style={menuItemStyle}
            onMouseEnter={e => (e.currentTarget.style.background = 'var(--ds-bg-surface-hover, #F5F7FA)')}
            onMouseLeave={e => (e.currentTarget.style.background = 'none')}
            onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}
          >
            Exported Log History
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

  const [visibleYears, setVisibleYears] = useState(3);
  const [totalYears, setTotalYears]     = useState(7);
  const [archiveEnabled, setArchiveEnabled] = useState(true);

  const [exemptEnabled, setExemptEnabled] = useState(false);
  const [modulesTags, setModulesTags] = useState([]);
  const [subformsTags, setSubformsTags] = useState([]);
  const modulesOptions = [
    { value: 'leads',          label: 'Leads'           },
    { value: 'contacts',       label: 'Contacts'        },
    { value: 'accounts',       label: 'Accounts'        },
    { value: 'deals',          label: 'Deals'           },
    { value: 'campaigns',      label: 'Campaigns'       },
    { value: 'tasks',          label: 'Tasks'           },
    { value: 'meetings',       label: 'Meetings'        },
    { value: 'calls',          label: 'Calls'           },
    { value: 'reports',        label: 'Reports'         },
    { value: 'quotes',         label: 'Quotes'          },
    { value: 'products',       label: 'Products'        },
    { value: 'invoices',       label: 'Invoices'        },
    { value: 'purchase-orders',label: 'Purchase Orders' },
    { value: 'sales-orders',   label: 'Sales Orders'   },
    { value: 'price-books',    label: 'Price Books'     },
    { value: 'cases',          label: 'Cases'           },
    { value: 'solutions',      label: 'Solutions'       },
    { value: 'documents',      label: 'Documents'       },
    { value: 'vendors',        label: 'Vendors'         },
    { value: 'activities',     label: 'Activities'      },
  ];
  const subformsOptions = [
    { value: 'line-items-deals',    label: 'Line Items',        tagLabel: 'Line Items (Deals)',        group: 'Deals' },
    { value: 'tax-details-deals',   label: 'Tax Details',       tagLabel: 'Tax Details (Deals)',       group: 'Deals' },
    { value: 'discount-deals',      label: 'Discount Details',  tagLabel: 'Discount Details (Deals)',  group: 'Deals' },
    { value: 'line-items-quotes',   label: 'Line Items',        tagLabel: 'Line Items (Quotes)',       group: 'Quotes' },
    { value: 'tax-details-quotes',  label: 'Tax Details',       tagLabel: 'Tax Details (Quotes)',      group: 'Quotes' },
    { value: 'shipping-quotes',     label: 'Shipping Charges',  tagLabel: 'Shipping Charges (Quotes)', group: 'Quotes' },
    { value: 'line-items-invoices', label: 'Line Items',        tagLabel: 'Line Items (Invoices)',     group: 'Invoices' },
    { value: 'tax-details-invoices',label: 'Tax Details',       tagLabel: 'Tax Details (Invoices)',    group: 'Invoices' },
    { value: 'line-items-po',       label: 'Line Items',        tagLabel: 'Line Items (Purchase Orders)', group: 'Purchase Orders' },
    { value: 'vendor-details-po',   label: 'Vendor Details',    tagLabel: 'Vendor Details (Purchase Orders)', group: 'Purchase Orders' },
  ];

  const archiveYears = totalYears - visibleYears;

  const today        = new Date('2026-08-18');
  const visibleStart = subtractYears(today, visibleYears);
  const archiveEnd   = subtractDays(visibleStart, 1);
  const archiveStart = subtractYears(archiveEnd, archiveYears);

  return (
    <>
      <Modal
        isOpen={open}
        title="Manage Log Retention Settings"
        description="Choose how long the logs should stay visible and archived in the Audit Log."
        onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
        onCancel={() => setOpen(false)}
        onSave={() => setConfirmOpen(true)}
        cancelLabel="Cancel"
        saveLabel="Save"
        width={640}
      >
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 20, paddingRight: 20 }}>

          {/* ── Dual range slider ───────────────────────────────────────── */}
          <div style={{ paddingTop: 4 }}>
            <DualRangeSlider
              min={0}
              max={10}
              maxA={3}
              valueA={visibleYears}
              valueB={totalYears}
              onChangeA={setVisibleYears}
              onChangeB={setTotalYears}
              showThumbB={archiveEnabled}
            />
          </div>

          {/* ── Archive checkbox ─────────────────────────────────────────── */}
          <Checkbox
            label="Archive"
            checked={archiveEnabled}
            onChange={(e) => setArchiveEnabled(e.target.checked)}
          />

          {/* ── Retention summary rows ───────────────────────────────────── */}
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 20 }}>
            <RetentionRow
              dotColor="var(--ds-components-slider-active-bg-fill-color, #5464F2)"
              showDot={true}
              label="Visible Log History"
              years={visibleYears}
              availableFrom={fmtDate(visibleStart)}
              availableTo="Now"
            />

            {archiveEnabled && archiveYears > 0 && (
              <RetentionRow
                dotColor="var(--ds-icon-primary-orange, #F18E0A)"
                label="Archived Logs Retention"
                years={archiveYears}
                availableFrom={fmtDate(archiveStart)}
                availableTo={fmtDate(archiveEnd)}
              />
            )}

            {/* Cleanup Period */}
            {(() => {
              const cleanupDate = archiveEnabled && archiveYears > 0 ? archiveStart : visibleStart;
              const rowText: React.CSSProperties = {
                fontFamily: 'var(--ds-font-family-base)',
                fontSize: 'var(--ds-font-size-base)',
                color: 'var(--ds-text-base)',
                lineHeight: '1.6',
              };
              return (
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 6 }}>
                  <div style={{
                    width: 8, height: 8,
                    borderRadius: '50%',
                    background: 'var(--ds-text-muted, #8C9BAB)',
                    flexShrink: 0,
                  }} />
                  <span style={{ ...rowText, fontWeight: 'var(--ds-font-weight-semibold)' as any }}>
                    Cleanup Period
                  </span>
                  <span style={rowText}>
                    : <strong style={{ fontWeight: 'var(--ds-font-weight-semibold)' as any }}>
                      Beyond {fmtDate(cleanupDate)}
                    </strong>
                  </span>
                </div>
              );
            })()}
          </div>

          {/* ── Select Modules to exempt from Standard Duration ─────────── */}
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 12 }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
              <Checkbox
                label="Select Modules to exempt from Standard Duration"
                checked={exemptEnabled}
                onChange={(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => setExemptEnabled(e.target.checked)}
              />
              <Tooltip
                content="Selected modules logs will not be populated in the audit log generation."
                placement="top"
                variant="white"
              >
                <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', color: 'var(--ds-text-label)' }}>
                  <InfoIcon width={14} height={14} />
                </span>
              </Tooltip>
            </div>

            {exemptEnabled && (
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 20 }}>
                {/* Modules */}
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 12 }}>
                  <span style={{
                    fontFamily: 'var(--ds-font-family-base)',
                    fontSize: 'var(--ds-font-size-base)',
                    fontWeight: 'var(--ds-font-weight-regular)' as any,
                    color: 'var(--ds-text-label)',
                    lineHeight: 'var(--ds-line-height-base)',
                    flexShrink: 0,
                    width: 140,
                    paddingTop: 8,
                    textAlign: 'right',
                  }}>
                    Modules
                  </span>
                  <Tags
                    value={modulesTags}
                    options={modulesOptions}
                    onChange={setModulesTags}
                    width={390}
                  />
                </div>

                {/* Subforms */}
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 12 }}>
                  <span style={{
                    fontFamily: 'var(--ds-font-family-base)',
                    fontSize: 'var(--ds-font-size-base)',
                    fontWeight: 'var(--ds-font-weight-regular)' as any,
                    color: 'var(--ds-text-label)',
                    lineHeight: 'var(--ds-line-height-base)',
                    flexShrink: 0,
                    width: 140,
                    paddingTop: 8,
                    textAlign: 'right',
                  }}>
                    Subforms
                  </span>
                  <Tags
                    value={subformsTags}
                    options={subformsOptions}
                    onChange={setSubformsTags}
                    width={390}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* ── Notes callout ────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
          <MessageInfo
            variant="note"
            points={[
              'Choose how long logs remain visible on the Audit Log page.',
              'Logs exceeding the visible limit are either archived or permanently deleted to free up storage space.',
              'Audit Logs (including Timeline and Interaction data) count towards your Data Storage.',
              'Archived logs use significantly less storage than active (visible) logs.',
            ]}
          />

          {/* ── Last updated ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
          <span style={{
            fontFamily: 'var(--ds-font-family-base)',
            fontSize: 'var(--ds-font-size-base)',
            color: 'var(--ds-text-label)',
          }}>
            Last updated : Aug 10, 2026 12:32 pm by Chinnaiya Raja
          </span>

        </div>
      </Modal>

      <Modal
        type="alert"
        variant="warning"
        isOpen={confirmOpen}
        title="Save audit log duration changes"
        description={
          <>
            <p>Existing logs follow the configured retention period then moving to archive if enabled or being deleted if disabled. Exempted modules stop generating new log, removing them resumes logging.</p>
            <div style={{ marginTop: 20 }}>
              <MessageInfo variant="note" message="Deleted logs cannot be recovered." />
            </div>
          </>
        }
        confirmLabel="Proceed"
        cancelLabel="Cancel"
        onClose={() => setConfirmOpen(false)}
        onCancel={() => setConfirmOpen(false)}
        onSave={() => {
          setConfirmOpen(false);
          setOpen(false);
          setSaved(true);
          setTimeout(() => setSaved(false), 4000);
        }}
        width={640}
      />

      {saved && (
        <>
          <style>{`
            @keyframes msgbox-slide-down {
              from { opacity: 0; top: 80px; }
              to   { opacity: 1; top: 100px; }
            }
          `}</style>
          <div style={{
            position: 'fixed', left: '50%',
            transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
            zIndex: 2000, minWidth: 320,
            animation: 'msgbox-slide-down 260ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0.2, 1) both',
          }}>
            <MessageBox
              variant="success"
              message="Log retention settings saved successfully."
              onClose={() => setSaved(false)}
            />
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

const GhostVariants = () => {
  const [openId, setOpenId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const toggle = (id: string) => setOpenId(prev => (prev === id ? null : id));
  const close = () => setOpenId(null);
  const W = (id: string, btn: React.ReactNode) => (
    <MenuWrap key={id} id={id} openId={openId} onClose={close} dropdownOffset="100%">{btn}</MenuWrap>
  );
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 16 }}>
      <Section title="Default">
        <Row>
          <Button variant="ghost-blue">Ghost Blue</Button>
          <Button variant="ghost-red">Ghost Red</Button>
        </Row>
      </Section>
      <Section title="With arrow — md (inline, no separator)">
        <Row>
          {W('gb', <Button variant="ghost-blue" size="md" arrow isOpen={openId === 'gb'} onClick={() => toggle('gb')}>More</Button>)}
          {W('gr', <Button variant="ghost-red" size="md" arrow isOpen={openId === 'gr'} onClick={() => toggle('gr')}>More</Button>)}
        </Row>
      </Section>
      <Section title="With arrow — sm (inline, no separator)">
        <Row>
          {W('gsb', <Button variant="ghost-blue" size="sm" arrow isOpen={openId === 'gsb'} onClick={() => toggle('gsb')}>More</Button>)}
          {W('gsr', <Button variant="ghost-red" size="sm" arrow isOpen={openId === 'gsr'} onClick={() => toggle('gsr')}>More</Button>)}
        </Row>
      </Section>
      <Section title="Hover">
        <Row>
          <Button variant="ghost-blue" forceState="hover">Ghost Blue</Button>
          <Button variant="ghost-red" forceState="hover">Ghost Red</Button>
          <Button variant="ghost-blue" arrow forceState="hover">More</Button>
          <Button variant="ghost-red" arrow forceState="hover">More</Button>
        </Row>
      </Section>
      <Section title="Active">
        <Row>
          <Button variant="ghost-blue" forceState="active">Ghost Blue</Button>
          <Button variant="ghost-red" forceState="active">Ghost Red</Button>
          <Button variant="ghost-blue" arrow isOpen>More</Button>
          <Button variant="ghost-red" arrow isOpen>More</Button>
        </Row>
      </Section>
      <Section title="Loader">
        <Row>
          <Button variant="ghost-blue" loading>Ghost Blue</Button>
          <Button variant="ghost-red" loading>Ghost Red</Button>
        </Row>
      </Section>
      <Section title="Disabled">
        <Row>
          <Button variant="ghost-blue" disabled>Ghost Blue</Button>
          <Button variant="ghost-red" disabled>Ghost Red</Button>
          <Button variant="ghost-blue" arrow disabled>More</Button>
          <Button variant="ghost-red" arrow disabled>More</Button>
        </Row>
      </Section>
    </div>
  );
};

const MenuButton = () => {
  const [openId, setOpenId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const toggle = (id: string) => setOpenId(prev => (prev === id ? null : id));
  const close = () => setOpenId(null);
  const W = (id: string, btn: React.ReactNode) => (
    <MenuWrap key={id} id={id} openId={openId} onClose={close}>{btn}</MenuWrap>
  );

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 24 }}>
      <Section title="Interactive — click arrow to open">
        <Row>
          {W('p', <Button variant="primary" size="md" arrow isOpen={openId === 'p'} onArrowClick={() => toggle('p')}>Actions</Button>)}
          {W('d', <Button variant="default" size="md" arrow isOpen={openId === 'd'} onArrowClick={() => toggle('d')}>Actions</Button>)}
          {W('n', <Button variant="negative" size="md" arrow isOpen={openId === 'n'} onArrowClick={() => toggle('n')}>Actions</Button>)}
          {W('s', <Button variant="success" size="md" arrow isOpen={openId === 's'} onArrowClick={() => toggle('s')}>Actions</Button>)}
        </Row>
        <Row>
          {W('ob', <Button variant="outline-blue" size="md" arrow isOpen={openId === 'ob'} onArrowClick={() => toggle('ob')}>Actions</Button>)}
          {W('og', <Button variant="outline-green" size="md" arrow isOpen={openId === 'og'} onArrowClick={() => toggle('og')}>Actions</Button>)}
          {W('or', <Button variant="outline-red" size="md" arrow isOpen={openId === 'or'} onArrowClick={() => toggle('or')}>Actions</Button>)}
        </Row>
      </Section>

      <Section title="Filled — md">
        <Row>
          {W('fp', <Button variant="primary" size="md" arrow isOpen={openId === 'fp'} onArrowClick={() => toggle('fp')}>Actions</Button>)}
          {W('fd', <Button variant="default" size="md" arrow isOpen={openId === 'fd'} onArrowClick={() => toggle('fd')}>Actions</Button>)}

const GroupButtonMeetingInvitation = () => {
  const [rsvp, setRsvp] = useState<string | undefined>(undefined);
  const [rsvpYes, setRsvpYes] = useState<string>('yes');
  const [rsvpMaybe, setRsvpMaybe] = useState<string>('maybe');
  const [rsvpNo, setRsvpNo] = useState<string>('no');

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 24 }}>
      <Section title="Interactive — collapses to single solid more button on selection">
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12 }}>
          <ButtonGroup options={RSVP_OPTIONS} value={rsvp} size="sm" onChange={setRsvp} />
          {rsvp && (
            <button
              onClick={() => setRsvp(undefined)}
              style={{
                fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--ds-text-muted)',
                background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer',
                padding: 0, fontFamily: 'var(--ds-font-family-base)',
              }}
            >
              Reset
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </Section>
      <Section title="Yes selected — single solid more button">
        <ButtonGroup options={RSVP_OPTIONS} value={rsvpYes} size="sm" onChange={setRsvpYes} />
      </Section>
      <Section title="Maybe selected">
        <ButtonGroup options={RSVP_OPTIONS} value={rsvpMaybe} size="sm" onChange={setRsvpMaybe} />
      </Section>
      <Section title="No selected">
        <ButtonGroup options={RSVP_OPTIONS} value={rsvpNo} size="sm" onChange={setRsvpNo} />
      </Section>
      <Section title="Default — no selection">
        <ButtonGroup options={RSVP_OPTIONS} size="sm" />
      </Section>
    </div>
  );
};

Default story ok
Default calendar — single date selection. Click any date to select it.

Selected Date story ok
Single date selected — June 24, 2019.
const SelectedDate = () => {
  const [value, setValue] = useState<Date | null>(new Date(2019, 5, 24));
  return (
    <Calendar
      mode="single"
      value={value}
      onChange={setValue}
      defaultMonth={new Date(2019, 5, 1)}
    />
  );
};
Date Range story ok
Hover to preview; click to start a range, click again to end it.
const DateRange = () => {
  const [start, setStart] = useState<Date | null>(new Date(2019, 5, 10));
  const [end,   setEnd]   = useState<Date | null>(new Date(2019, 5, 20));
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 12, alignItems: 'center' }}>
      <Calendar
        mode="range"
        rangeStart={start}
        rangeEnd={end}
        onRangeChange={(s, e) => { setStart(s); setEnd(e); }}
        defaultMonth={new Date(2019, 5, 1)}
      />
      <p style={{ fontFamily: 'var(--ds-font-family-base)', fontSize: 12, color: '#616E88', margin: 0 }}>
        {start ? `${start.toDateString()} → ${end ? end.toDateString() : '...'}` : 'Click a date to start'}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
};
Multi Date Select story ok
Multi date selection — toggle individual dates.
const MultiDateSelect = () => {
  const [dates, setDates] = useState<Date[]>([
    new Date(2019, 5, 3),
    new Date(2019, 5, 7),
    new Date(2019, 5, 14),
    new Date(2019, 5, 21),
  ]);
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 12, alignItems: 'center' }}>
      <Calendar
        mode="multi"
        selectedDates={dates}
        onMultiChange={setDates}
        defaultMonth={new Date(2019, 5, 1)}
      />
      <p style={{ fontFamily: 'var(--ds-font-family-base)', fontSize: 12, color: '#616E88', margin: 0 }}>
        {dates.length} date{dates.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''} selected
      </p>
    </div>
  );
};

import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react';
import colorTokens from './tokens/color.json';

interface ColorToken {
  path: string;
  hex: string;
  alpha: number;
  isAlias: boolean;
}

interface TokenGroup {
  group: string;
  tokens: ColorToken[];
}

type TokenNode = {
  $type?: string;
  $value?: { hex: string; alpha: number } | string;
  [key: string]: unknown;
};

function collectTokens(node: TokenNode, pathParts: string[]): ColorToken[] {
  if (node.$type === 'color') {
    const val = node.$value;
    if (typeof val === 'string') {
      return [{ path: pathParts.join('.'), hex: '#888888', alpha: 1, isAlias: true }];
    }
    if (val && typeof val === 'object' && 'hex' in val) {
      return [{ path: pathParts.join('.'), hex: val.hex as string, alpha: (val.alpha as number) ?? 1, isAlias: false }];
    }
    return [];
  }

  const results: ColorToken[] = [];
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(node)) {
    if (key.startsWith('$')) continue;
    if (value && typeof value === 'object') {
      results.push(...collectTokens(value as TokenNode, [...pathParts, key]));
    }
  }
  return results;
}

function buildGroups(): TokenGroup[] {
  const groups: TokenGroup[] = [];
  for (const [groupKey, groupValue] of Object.entries(colorTokens)) {
    if (groupKey.startsWith('$')) continue;
    const tokens = collectTokens(groupValue as TokenNode, [groupKey]);
    if (tokens.length > 0) {
      groups.push({ group: groupKey, tokens });
    }
  }
  return groups;
}

const groups = buildGroups();

function hexToRgba(hex: string, alpha: number): string {
  const clean = hex.replace('#', '');
  const r = parseInt(clean.substring(0, 2), 16);
  const g = parseInt(clean.substring(2, 4), 16);
  const b = parseInt(clean.substring(4, 6), 16);
  return `rgba(${r}, ${g}, ${b}, ${alpha.toFixed(2)})`;
}

function getLuminance(hex: string): number {
  const clean = hex.replace('#', '');
  const r = parseInt(clean.substring(0, 2), 16) / 255;
  const g = parseInt(clean.substring(2, 4), 16) / 255;
  const b = parseInt(clean.substring(4, 6), 16) / 255;
  return 0.2126 * r + 0.7152 * g + 0.0722 * b;
}

function SwatchCard({ token }: { token: ColorToken }) {
  const bg = token.isAlias ? '#888888' : hexToRgba(token.hex, token.alpha);
  const textColor = getLuminance(token.isAlias ? '#888888' : token.hex) > 0.4 ? '#1a1a2e' : '#ffffff';
  const shortPath = token.path.split('.').slice(1).join('.');

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', width: 160 }}>
      <div
        title={token.path}
        style={{
          height: 72,
          borderRadius: 8,
          background: bg,
          border: '1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08)',
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'flex-end',
          padding: '6px 8px',
          boxSizing: 'border-box',
        }}
      >
        {token.isAlias && (
          <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: textColor, opacity: 0.8 }}>alias</span>
        )}
      </div>
      <div style={{ marginTop: 6 }}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600, color: '#1a1a2e', lineHeight: 1.3, wordBreak: 'break-all' }}>
          {shortPath || token.path}
        </div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: '#6b7280', marginTop: 2, fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>
          {token.isAlias ? 'alias' : token.hex.toUpperCase()}
          {!token.isAlias && token.alpha < 1 && ` / ${Math.round(token.alpha * 100)}%`}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

const GROUP_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  bg: 'Background',
  text: 'Text',
  border: 'Border',
  neutral: 'Neutral',
  icon: 'Icon',
  status: 'Status',
  shadow: 'Shadow',
  focus: 'Focus',
  components: 'Components',
  products: 'Products',
};

function ColorFoundationsPage() {
  return (
    <div style={{ fontFamily: 'system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif', padding: 32, background: '#f8f9fb', minHeight: '100vh' }}>
      <div style={{ marginBottom: 40 }}>
        <h1 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 28, fontWeight: 700, color: '#111827' }}>Color Foundations</h1>
        <p style={{ margin: '8px 0 0', color: '#6b7280', fontSize: 15 }}>
          {groups.reduce((n, g) => n + g.tokens.length, 0)} tokens across {groups.length} groups — Day Mode NXT GEN
        </p>
      </div>

      {groups.map(({ group, tokens }) => (
        <section key={group} style={{ marginBottom: 48 }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'baseline', gap: 10, marginBottom: 20 }}>
            <h2 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 600, color: '#1f2937', textTransform: 'capitalize' }}>
              {GROUP_LABELS[group] ?? group}
            </h2>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 13, color: '#9ca3af' }}>{tokens.length} tokens</span>
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 20 }}>
            {tokens.map((token) => (
              <SwatchCard key={token.path} token={token} />
            ))}
          </div>
        </section>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

const meta: Meta = {
  title: 'Design System/Foundations/Colors',
  component: ColorFoundationsPage,
  parameters: {
    layout: 'fullscreen',
    docs: {
      description: {
        component: 'All color design tokens from the Day Mode NXT GEN token set, grouped by category.',
      },
    },
  },
};

export default meta;

export const AllColors: StoryObj = {
  name: 'All Colors',
  render: () => <ColorFoundationsPage />,
};

import { useId, useState } from 'react';
import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react-vite';
import { expect, userEvent, within } from 'storybook/test';
import { Button } from '../components/Button/Button';
import { Checkbox } from '../components/Checkbox/Checkbox';
import { Icon } from '../components/Icon/Icon';
import { Input } from '../components/Input/Input';
import { Dropdown } from '../components/Dropdown/Dropdown';
import { ProgressBar } from '../components/ProgressBar/ProgressBar';
import { SetupTable } from '../components/Table/Table';
import { CrmHomepage } from './CrmHomepage.stories';
import { DEALS, INITIAL_TASKS, PERFORMANCE, PERIODS } from './CrmHomepage.data';
import type { Period } from './CrmHomepage.data';
import { KPI_TRENDS, LEADERBOARD, SALES_CHARTS } from './Colorful.data';
import './Colorful.css';

const meta = {
  title: 'Design System/Patterns/crm-homepage/colorful',
  parameters: {
    layout: 'fullscreen',
    docs: { description: { component: 'A colorful sales workspace with exactly 20 widgets: six KPI cards with mini charts, eight accessible charts, and six daily-work sections. Reuses the CRM shell and existing controls. SVG data illustrations are local to this story, not new design-system components. Chart detail tables expose every plotted value. All data is illustrative and actions are local.' } },
  },
} satisfies Meta;
export default meta;
type Story = StoryObj<typeof meta>;
const COLUMNS = [
  { key: 'name', label: 'Account', width: 190 }, { key: 'stage', label: 'Stage', width: 130 },
  { key: 'amount', label: 'Value', width: 100 }, { key: 'close', label: 'Closing', width: 90 },
];

// Story-local composition; existing CRM navigation and header remain unchanged.
function ColorfulPage() {
  const id = useId();
  const [period, setPeriod] = useState<Period>('month');
  const [tasks, setTasks] = useState(INITIAL_TASKS);
  const [followUpOnly, setFollowUpOnly] = useState(false);
  const [question, setQuestion] = useState('');
  const [answer, setAnswer] = useState('');
  const [goalDetails, setGoalDetails] = useState(false);
  const performance = PERFORMANCE[period];
  const metrics = [
    { title: 'Closed revenue', value: performance.revenue, detail: `${performance.changes[0]} vs. previous ${period}` },
    { title: 'Open pipeline', value: performance.pipeline, detail: '4 opportunities · all closing dates' },
    { title: 'Deals won', value: performance.deals, detail: `${performance.changes[1]} vs. previous ${period}` },
    { title: 'New leads', value: performance.leads, detail: `${performance.changes[2]} vs. previous ${period}` },
    { title: 'Lead conversion', value: performance.conversion, detail: `${performance.changes[3]} vs. previous ${period}` },
    { title: 'Average won deal', value: period === 'month' ? '$7,042' : '$7,235', detail: 'Closed revenue ÷ deals won' },
  ];
  const rows = followUpOnly ? DEALS.filter(deal => deal.id === 'northstar') : DEALS;
  return <CrmHomepage><div className="crm-colorful" aria-labelledby={`${id}-title`}>
    <div className="crm-colorful__heading">
      <div><p className="crm-colorful__eyebrow">A LITTLE MOMENTUM GOES A LONG WAY</p><h1 id={`${id}-title`}>Good morning, Ananya.</h1><p>Your sales world, in full color.</p></div>
      <Dropdown options={PERIODS} value={period} width="fit-content" onChange={(value: string) => setPeriod(value as Period)} />
    </div>
    <p className="crm-colorful__scope">KPIs follow the selected period. Charts show the fixed periods in their captions. All figures are sample data.</p>
    <div className="crm-colorful__grid" role="region" aria-label="20 sales widgets">
      {metrics.map((metric, index) => <section className="crm-colorful__card crm-colorful__kpi" data-tone={index} data-sales-widget key={metric.title} aria-label={metric.title}>
        <div className="crm-colorful__section-heading"><h2>{metric.title}</h2><span className="crm-colorful__metric-icon"><Icon name={['WmsMotivator', 'CompanyAvatar', 'Check', 'GroupAvatar', 'WmsChannel', 'WmsNotes'][index]} /></span></div>
        <div className="crm-colorful__metric-value"><strong className="crm-colorful__value">{metric.value}</strong>{[0, 2, 3, 4].includes(index) && <span className="crm-colorful__change">{performance.changes[index === 0 ? 0 : index - 1]}</span>}</div>
        <p>{metric.detail}</p>
        <svg className="crm-colorful__mini" viewBox="0 0 160 48" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">
          <polyline points={KPI_TRENDS[index].map((value, point) => `${point * 26},${46 - value / 2}`).join(' ')} fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="3" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
        </svg><span className="crm-colorful__caption">Illustrative trend</span>
      </section>)}
      {SALES_CHARTS.map((chart, index) => {
        const max = Math.max(...chart.series.map(item => item.value));
        const total = chart.series.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.value, 0);
        let offset = 0;
        const points = chart.series.map((item, point) => `${20 + point * 280 / (chart.series.length - 1)},${140 - item.value / max * 110}`).join(' ');
        const summary = chart.series.map(item => `${item.label}: ${item.display}`).join('; ');
        return <section className={`crm-colorful__card crm-colorful__chart ${chart.title === 'Revenue trend' ? 'crm-colorful__card--wide' : ''}`} data-tone={index % 6} data-sales-widget key={chart.title} aria-labelledby={`${id}-chart-${index}`}>
          <div className="crm-colorful__section-heading"><h2 id={`${id}-chart-${index}`}>{chart.title}</h2><span className="crm-colorful__dot" aria-hidden="true" /></div>
          <p className="crm-colorful__caption">{chart.subtitle}</p>
          {chart.title === 'Revenue trend' && <div className="crm-colorful__chart-stat"><strong className="crm-colorful__value">$429K</strong><span className="crm-colorful__caption">Total booked · January–June</span></div>}
          {chart.title === 'Weekly activity' && <div className="crm-colorful__activity" role="img" aria-label={`${chart.title}. ${summary}`}>
            {chart.series.map(item => <div className="crm-colorful__activity-day" key={item.label} data-peak={item.value === max || undefined}><strong>{item.value}</strong><div className="crm-colorful__activity-track"><span style={{ height: `${item.value / max * 100}%` }} /></div><span>{item.label.slice(0, 3)}</span></div>)}
          </div>}
          {chart.kind === 'line' && chart.title !== 'Weekly activity' && <>
            <svg className="crm-colorful__line" viewBox="0 0 320 160" role="img" aria-label={`${chart.title}. ${summary}`}>
              {[30, 85, 140].map(y => <line key={y} x1="20" x2="300" y1={y} y2={y} className="crm-colorful__gridline" />)}
              <polygon points={`20,140 ${points} 300,140`} className="crm-colorful__area" />
              <polyline points={points} fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="3" strokeLinejoin="round" />
              {chart.series.map((item, point) => <circle key={item.label} cx={20 + point * 280 / (chart.series.length - 1)} cy={140 - item.value / max * 110} r="4" fill="currentColor"><title>{item.label}: {item.display}</title></circle>)}
            </svg><div className="crm-colorful__axis" aria-hidden="true">{chart.series.map(item => <span key={item.label}>{item.label.slice(0, 3)}</span>)}</div>
          </>}
          {chart.title === 'Revenue goal' && <div className="crm-colorful__goal">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 240 150" className="crm-colorful__gauge" role="img" aria-label="June revenue goal: $84,500 of $120,000 booked, 70.4 percent achieved">
              <path d="M 25 125 A 95 95 0 0 1 215 125" fill="none" className="crm-colorful__gauge-track" strokeWidth="24" />
              <path d="M 25 125 A 95 95 0 0 1 215 125" fill="none" className="crm-colorful__gauge-fill" pathLength="100" strokeDasharray="70.4 100" strokeWidth="24" />
              <path d="M 25 125 A 95 95 0 0 1 215 125" fill="none" className="crm-colorful__gauge-dividers" pathLength="100" strokeDasharray="0.8 1.7" strokeWidth="26" />
            </svg>
            <div className="crm-colorful__goal-label"><strong className="crm-colorful__value">70.4%</strong><p className="crm-colorful__caption">$35,500 to reach your target</p></div>
            <Button variant="default" onClick={() => setGoalDetails(current => !current)} aria-expanded={goalDetails}>{goalDetails ? 'Hide goal details' : 'Show goal details'}</Button>
            {goalDetails && <p role="status" className="crm-colorful__caption">June target: $120,000. Booked: $84,500. Remaining: $35,500.</p>}
          </div>}
          {chart.kind === 'donut' && chart.title !== 'Revenue goal' && <div className="crm-colorful__donut-layout">
            <svg className="crm-colorful__donut" viewBox="0 0 120 120" role="img" aria-label={`${chart.title}. ${summary}`}>
              {chart.series.map((item, segment) => {
                const start = offset; const share = item.value / total * 100; offset += share;
                return <circle key={item.label} cx="60" cy="60" r="44" fill="none" pathLength="100" strokeWidth="14" strokeDasharray={`${share} ${100 - share}`} strokeDashoffset={-start} transform="rotate(-90 60 60)" className={`crm-colorful__segment crm-colorful__segment--${segment}`} />;
              })}
            </svg><ul className="crm-colorful__legend">{chart.series.map((item, segment) => <li key={item.label}><span className={`crm-colorful__segment--${segment}`} aria-hidden="true">●</span><div>{item.label}<strong>{item.display}</strong></div></li>)}</ul>
          </div>}
          {chart.kind === 'bars' && <div className="crm-colorful__bars">{chart.series.map((item, bar) => <div key={item.label} className="crm-colorful__bar-row">
            <div className="crm-colorful__section-heading"><span>{item.label}</span><strong>{item.display}</strong></div>
            <div role="meter" aria-label={item.label} aria-valuemin={0} aria-valuemax={max} aria-valuenow={item.value} aria-valuetext={item.display}><ProgressBar value={item.value / max * 100} color={bar % 2 ? 'green' : 'blue'} /></div>
          </div>)}</div>}
          {chart.title === 'Revenue trend' && <div className="crm-colorful__customer-breakdown" aria-label="Revenue by customer segment">
            <h3>Customer segments</h3><div>{[{ name: 'Enterprise', value: '$214,500', share: 50 }, { name: 'Mid-market', value: '$150,150', share: 35 }, { name: 'Small business', value: '$64,350', share: 15 }].map((segment, tone) => <div className="crm-colorful__customer-segment" data-tone={tone} key={segment.name}><strong>{segment.value}</strong><span className="crm-colorful__caption">{segment.name} · {segment.share}%</span><ProgressBar value={segment.share} color={tone === 1 ? 'green' : 'blue'} /></div>)}</div>
          </div>}
          <details className="crm-colorful__details"><summary>View chart data</summary><table><caption>{chart.title}</caption><thead><tr><th scope="col">Category</th><th scope="col">Value</th></tr></thead><tbody>{chart.series.map(item => <tr key={item.label}><th scope="row">{item.label}</th><td>{item.display}</td></tr>)}</tbody></table></details>
        </section>;
      })}
      <section id={`${id}-deals-anchor`} className="crm-colorful__card crm-colorful__card--wide" data-tone="0" data-sales-widget aria-label="Open deals">
        <div className="crm-colorful__section-heading"><h2>Open deals</h2><span role="status">{rows.length} opportunities</span></div>
        <div className="crm-colorful__table"><SetupTable columns={COLUMNS} rows={rows} selectable={false} width="100%" /></div>
        <Button variant="link-primary" onClick={() => setFollowUpOnly(current => !current)} aria-pressed={followUpOnly}>{followUpOnly ? 'Show all deals' : 'Review follow-up'}</Button>
      </section>
      <section className="crm-colorful__card" data-tone="1" data-sales-widget aria-label="Priority tasks">
        <div className="crm-colorful__section-heading"><h2>Priority tasks</h2><span role="status">{tasks.filter(task => !task.completed).length} remaining</span></div>
        <ul className="crm-colorful__list">{tasks.map(task => <li key={task.id}><Checkbox label={task.title} checked={task.completed} onChange={() => setTasks(current => current.map(item => item.id === task.id ? { ...item, completed: !item.completed } : item))} /><p className="crm-colorful__caption">{task.detail}</p></li>)}</ul>
      </section>
      <section className="crm-colorful__card" data-tone="2" data-sales-widget aria-label="Team leaderboard">
        <h2>Team leaderboard</h2><p className="crm-colorful__caption">June · $120,000 individual goals</p>
        <ol className="crm-colorful__list">{LEADERBOARD.map(person => <li key={person.name}><div className="crm-colorful__section-heading"><strong>{person.name}</strong><span>{person.revenue}</span></div><p className="crm-colorful__caption">{person.deals} · {person.progress}% of goal</p><div role="progressbar" aria-label={`${person.name} goal`} aria-valuemin={0} aria-valuemax={100} aria-valuenow={person.progress}><ProgressBar value={person.progress} color="green" /></div></li>)}</ol>
      </section>
      <section className="crm-colorful__card" data-tone="3" data-sales-widget aria-label="Upcoming meetings">
        <h2>Upcoming meetings</h2><p className="crm-colorful__caption">Today · demo agenda</p><ul className="crm-colorful__list"><li><span className="crm-colorful__pill">10:30 AM · 30 min</span><h3>Discovery call</h3><p>Atlas Logistics · Daniel Kim</p></li><li><span className="crm-colorful__pill">2:00 PM · 45 min</span><h3>Proposal review</h3><p>Meridian Health · Sofia Martinez</p></li></ul>
      </section>
      <section className="crm-colorful__card" data-tone="4" data-sales-widget aria-label="Sales insights">
        <h2>Sales insights</h2><ul className="crm-colorful__list"><li><span className="crm-colorful__pill">FOLLOW-UP DUE</span><h3>Keep Northstar moving</h3><p>$32,000 closes June 26. Confirm the next step with Priya.</p></li><li><h3>Protect your largest opportunity</h3><p>Evergreen represents 35% of the open pipeline. Review renewal terms before July 8.</p></li></ul>
        <Button variant="link-primary" onClick={() => { setFollowUpOnly(true); document.getElementById(`${id}-deals-anchor`)?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); }}>Review Northstar</Button>
      </section>
      <section className="crm-colorful__card crm-colorful__assistant" data-tone="0" data-sales-widget aria-label="Sales assistant">
        <div className="crm-colorful__section-heading"><h2>Sales assistant</h2><Icon name="WmsZia" /></div>
        <div className="crm-colorful__assistant-visual" aria-hidden="true"><span className="crm-colorful__assistant-orb" /></div>
        <p className="crm-colorful__caption">A little help with your next move. Local demo, not a connected AI service.</p>
        <form className="crm-colorful__assistant-form" onSubmit={event => { event.preventDefault(); if (question.trim()) setAnswer('Based on this sample workspace: follow up on Northstar ($32,000), send the Meridian proposal ($24,500), and review Evergreen renewal terms ($41,000).'); }}>
          <Input width="100%" layout="vertical" aria-label="Ask the sales assistant" placeholder="What should I focus on?" value={question} onChange={(event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => setQuestion(event.target.value)} />
          <Button type="submit" variant="primary" disabled={!question.trim()} aria-label="Ask assistant">Ask</Button>
        </form>
        {answer && <p role="status" className="crm-colorful__notice">{answer}</p>}
      </section>
    </div>
    <footer className="crm-colorful__caption">20 sales widgets · Sample workspace · No live CRM records are changed</footer>
  </div></CrmHomepage>;
}
export const Default: Story = {
  render: () => <ColorfulPage />,
  play: async ({ canvasElement }) => {
    const canvas = within(canvasElement);
    await expect(canvas.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Good morning, Ananya.' })).toBeVisible();
    await expect(canvasElement.querySelectorAll('[data-sales-widget]')).toHaveLength(20);
    await expect(within(canvas.getByRole('region', { name: '20 sales widgets' })).getAllByRole('img')).toHaveLength(5);
    await expect(canvas.getByRole('img', { name: /June revenue goal/ })).toBeVisible();
    await expect(canvas.getByLabelText('Revenue by customer segment')).toBeVisible();
    const revenue = within(canvas.getByRole('region', { name: 'Closed revenue' }));
    await expect(revenue.getByText('$84,500')).toBeVisible();
    await userEvent.click(canvas.getByRole('button', { name: 'This month' }));
    await userEvent.click(within(canvasElement.ownerDocument.body).getByRole('option', { name: 'This quarter' }));
    await expect(revenue.getByText('$246,000')).toBeVisible();
    const tasks = within(canvas.getByRole('region', { name: 'Priority tasks' }));
    await userEvent.click(tasks.getAllByRole('checkbox')[0]);
    await expect(tasks.getByText('2 remaining')).toBeVisible();
    await userEvent.click(canvas.getByRole('button', { name: 'Review follow-up' }));
    await expect(canvas.getByText('1 opportunities')).toBeVisible();
    await userEvent.click(canvas.getByRole('button', { name: 'Show all deals' }));
    await expect(canvas.getByText('4 opportunities', { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
    await userEvent.click(canvas.getByRole('button', { name: 'Show goal details' }));
    await expect(canvas.getByText(/June target: \$120,000/)).toBeVisible();
    const assistant = within(canvas.getByRole('region', { name: 'Sales assistant' }));
    await expect(assistant.getByRole('button', { name: 'Ask assistant' })).toBeDisabled();
    await userEvent.type(assistant.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Ask the sales assistant' }), 'What should I prioritize?');
    await userEvent.click(assistant.getByRole('button', { name: 'Ask assistant' }));
    await expect(assistant.getByRole('status')).toHaveTextContent('Based on this sample workspace');
    const trend = within(canvas.getByRole('region', { name: 'Revenue trend' }));
    await userEvent.click(trend.getByText('View chart data'));
    await expect(trend.getByRole('cell', { name: '$54,000' })).toBeVisible();
  },
};

import { useId, useState } from 'react';
import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react-vite';
import { expect, userEvent, within } from 'storybook/test';
import { NextGenTopBand } from '../components/NextGenTopBand/NextGenTopBand';
import { NextGenLeftMenu } from '../components/NextGenLeftMenu/NextGenLeftMenu';
import { WMSBar } from '../components/WMSBar/WMSBar';
import { Button } from '../components/Button/Button';
import { Checkbox } from '../components/Checkbox/Checkbox';
import { Dropdown } from '../components/Dropdown/Dropdown';
import { FormSection } from '../components/FormSection/FormSection';
import { MessageInfo } from '../components/MessageInfo/MessageInfo';
import { ProgressBar } from '../components/ProgressBar/ProgressBar';
import { SetupTable } from '../components/Table/Table';
import './CrmHomepage.css';

const meta = {
  title: 'Design System/Patterns/crm-homepage',
  includeStories: ['Default', 'EmptyState'],
  parameters: {
    layout: 'fullscreen',
    docs: { description: { component: 'A sales command center with CRM navigation, KPIs, performance breakdown, actionable insights, deals, daily tasks, meetings, and recent conversations. Composed from existing components; all data and interactions are local examples.' } },
  },
} satisfies Meta;
export default meta;
type Story = StoryObj<typeof meta>;
import { CHATS, DEALS, INITIAL_TASKS, PERFORMANCE, PERIODS } from './CrmHomepage.data';
import type { Period } from './CrmHomepage.data';
const DEAL_COLUMNS = [
  { key: 'name', label: 'Account', width: 190 },
  { key: 'stage', label: 'Stage', width: 130 },
  { key: 'amount', label: 'Amount', width: 100 },
  { key: 'close', label: 'Close date', width: 90 },
  { key: 'attention', label: 'Next step', width: 140 },
];
const PIPELINE = [
  { label: 'Qualification', amount: '$18,000', count: 1, share: 16 },
  { label: 'Proposal', amount: '$24,500', count: 1, share: 21 },
  { label: 'Negotiation', amount: '$73,000', count: 2, share: 63 },
];
const MEETINGS = [
  { id: 'discovery', time: '10:30', title: 'Discovery call', account: 'Atlas Logistics · Daniel Kim', duration: 'AM · 30 min' },
  { id: 'review', time: '14:00', title: 'Proposal review', account: 'Meridian Health · Sofia Martinez', duration: '45 min' },
];

// Story-local composition, not a new design-system component.
export function CrmHomepage({ empty = false, children, showTerritory = true, workspaceName = 'Sales workspace' }: { empty?: boolean; children?: ReactNode; showTerritory?: boolean; workspaceName?: string }) {
  const headingId = useId();
  const [period, setPeriod] = useState<Period>('month');
  const [tasks, setTasks] = useState(empty ? [] : INITIAL_TASKS);
  const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [showCompleted, setShowCompleted] = useState(false);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState('');
  const [activeChat, setActiveChat] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [readChats, setReadChats] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [attentionOnly, setAttentionOnly] = useState(false);
  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const performance = PERFORMANCE[period];
  const pendingTasks = tasks.filter(task => !task.completed);
  const visibleTasks = showCompleted ? tasks : pendingTasks;
  const visibleDeals = empty ? [] : attentionOnly ? DEALS.filter(deal => deal.id === 'northstar') : DEALS;
  const selectedChat = CHATS.find(chat => chat.id === activeChat);
  const unreadCount = empty ? 0 : CHATS.filter(chat => chat.unread && !readChats.includes(chat.id)).length;
  const metrics = [
    { label: 'Closed revenue', value: empty ? '$0' : performance.revenue, detail: 'Revenue booked', change: performance.changes[0] },
    { label: 'Deals won', value: empty ? '0' : performance.deals, detail: 'Closed opportunities', change: performance.changes[1] },
    { label: 'New leads', value: empty ? '0' : performance.leads, detail: 'Added to your pipeline', change: performance.changes[2] },
    { label: 'Lead conversion', value: empty ? '0%' : performance.conversion, detail: 'Leads converted to deals', change: performance.changes[3] },
  ];
  const openChat = (id: string) => {
    setActiveChat(id);
    setReadChats(current => current.includes(id) ? current : [...current, id]);
  };

  return (
    <div className="crm-homepage">
      <div className="crm-homepage__shell">
        <aside className="crm-homepage__sidebar" data-open={menuOpen || undefined} aria-label="CRM navigation">
          <NextGenLeftMenu activeId="home" teamspaceName={workspaceName} onItemClick={(id: string) => {
            setMenuOpen(false);
            if (id !== 'home') setNotice(`${id.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + id.slice(1)} selected. Navigation is a local preview; no CRM records are changed.`);
          }} />
        </aside>
        <div className="crm-homepage__workspace">
          <header>
            <NextGenTopBand moduleLabel="Home" userInitials="AS" userAvatarSrc={`${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}images/avatars/user_06.jpg`} showTerritory={showTerritory}
              onAddNew={() => setNotice('Quick create selected. In a connected CRM, this opens record creation.')}
              onCalendar={() => document.getElementById(`${headingId}-meetings`)?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' })} />
          </header>
          <main className="crm-homepage__main" aria-labelledby={children ? undefined : headingId} aria-label={children ? 'CRM homepage' : undefined}>
            <div className="crm-homepage__mobile-menu">
              <Button variant="default" aria-expanded={menuOpen} onClick={() => setMenuOpen(current => !current)}>{menuOpen ? 'Close navigation' : 'Open navigation'}</Button>
            </div>
            {children && notice && <div role="status"><MessageInfo variant="info" message={notice} /></div>}
            {children ?? <>
            <div className="crm-homepage__heading">
              <div>
                <p className="crm-homepage__eyebrow">YOUR SALES WORKSPACE · FRIDAY, JUNE 19</p>
                <h1 id={headingId}>Welcome back, Ananya</h1>
                <p>{empty ? 'Your next chapter starts here. Build your pipeline and plan your day.' : 'A strong month so far. Let’s keep your next opportunities moving.'}</p>
              </div>
              <Dropdown label="Reporting period" layout="vertical" width="fit-content" options={PERIODS} value={period} onChange={(value: string) => setPeriod(value as Period)} />
            </div>
            {notice && <div role="status"><MessageInfo variant="info" message={notice} /></div>}
            <section aria-label="Sales overview">
              <dl className="crm-homepage__metrics">
                {metrics.map((metric, index) => (
                  <div key={metric.label} className="crm-homepage__metric" data-tone={index}>
                    <dt>{metric.label}</dt><dd>{metric.value}</dd>
                    <div className="crm-homepage__metric-change"><span>{empty ? '—' : metric.change}</span> <span>vs. previous {period}</span></div>
                    <p>{metric.detail}</p>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </dl>
            </section>
            <div className="crm-homepage__dashboard">
              <div className="crm-homepage__primary">
                <section className="crm-homepage__panel" aria-label="Sales performance">
                  <FormSection title="Sales performance">
                    <div className="crm-homepage__section-heading"><p>Progress toward your {period === 'month' ? 'monthly' : 'quarterly'} revenue goal</p><span className="crm-homepage__badge">{period === 'month' ? 'June 2026' : 'Q2 2026'}</span></div>
                    <div className="crm-homepage__performance">
                      <section className="crm-homepage__target" aria-label="Revenue target">
                        <p>Revenue target</p>
                        <div className="crm-homepage__target-value">{empty ? '0' : performance.progress}<span>%</span></div>
                        <p>{empty ? 'Start closing deals to build momentum.' : `${performance.remaining} to reach your goal`}</p>
                        <div role="progressbar" aria-label="Revenue target progress" aria-valuemin={0} aria-valuemax={100} aria-valuenow={empty ? 0 : performance.progress} aria-valuetext={`${empty ? '$0' : performance.revenue} of ${performance.target}`}>
                          <ProgressBar value={empty ? 0 : performance.progress} leftLabel={empty ? '$0' : performance.revenue} rightLabel={performance.target} />
                        </div>
                      </section>
                      <section className="crm-homepage__pipeline" aria-label="Pipeline by stage">
                        <div className="crm-homepage__section-heading"><h2>Pipeline by stage</h2><strong>{empty ? '$0' : performance.pipeline}</strong></div>
                        {PIPELINE.map(stage => <div key={stage.label} className="crm-homepage__stage">
                          <div className="crm-homepage__section-heading"><p>{stage.label} <span>· {empty ? 0 : stage.count} {stage.count === 1 ? 'deal' : 'deals'}</span></p><strong>{empty ? '$0' : stage.amount}</strong></div>
                          <div role="meter" aria-label={`${stage.label} share of pipeline`} aria-valuemin={0} aria-valuemax={100} aria-valuenow={empty ? 0 : stage.share}>
                            <ProgressBar value={empty ? 0 : stage.share} />
                          </div>
                        </div>)}
                        <p className="crm-homepage__caption">Share of open pipeline value · all closing dates</p>
                      </section>
                    </div>
                  </FormSection>
                </section>
                <section className="crm-homepage__panel" aria-label="Open deals">
                  <FormSection title="Open deals">
                    <div className="crm-homepage__section-heading"><p>{attentionOnly ? 'Opportunities with a follow-up due.' : 'Your next opportunities, ordered by closing date.'}</p><span role="status">{selectedIds.length} selected</span></div>
                    {attentionOnly && <Button variant="link-primary" onClick={() => { setAttentionOnly(false); setSelectedIds([]); }}>Show all deals</Button>}
                    <SetupTable columns={DEAL_COLUMNS} rows={visibleDeals} selectable selectedIds={selectedIds} onSelectionChange={setSelectedIds} width="100%" emptyMessage="No open deals yet. New opportunities will appear here." />
                  </FormSection>
                </section>
                <div className="crm-homepage__columns">
                  <section className="crm-homepage__panel" aria-label="Today's tasks">
                    <FormSection title="Today's tasks">
                      <div className="crm-homepage__section-heading"><span role="status">{pendingTasks.length} tasks remaining</span><Button variant="link-primary" onClick={() => setShowCompleted(current => !current)} aria-pressed={showCompleted}>{showCompleted ? 'Hide completed' : 'Show completed'}</Button></div>
                      {visibleTasks.length ? <ul className="crm-homepage__list">{visibleTasks.map(task => <li key={task.id} className="crm-homepage__task" data-completed={task.completed || undefined}>
                        <Checkbox label={task.title} checked={task.completed} onChange={() => setTasks(current => current.map(item => item.id === task.id ? { ...item, completed: !item.completed } : item))} /><p>{task.detail}</p>
                      </li>)}</ul> : <p className="crm-homepage__empty">{tasks.length ? 'All caught up! No pending tasks.' : 'No tasks scheduled for today.'}</p>}
                    </FormSection>
                  </section>
                  <section id={`${headingId}-meetings`} className="crm-homepage__panel" aria-label="Upcoming meetings">
                    <FormSection title="Upcoming meetings">
                      <p>Today · Friday, June 19, 2026</p>
                      {empty ? <p className="crm-homepage__empty">No meetings scheduled for today.</p> : <ul className="crm-homepage__list">{MEETINGS.map(meeting => <li key={meeting.id} className="crm-homepage__meeting">
                        <div className="crm-homepage__time"><strong>{meeting.time}</strong><span>{meeting.duration}</span></div><div><h2>{meeting.title}</h2><p>{meeting.account}</p></div>
                      </li>)}</ul>}
                    </FormSection>
                  </section>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="crm-homepage__context">
                <section className="crm-homepage__panel crm-homepage__insights" aria-label="Sales insights">
                  <FormSection title="Insights for you">
                    <p>Small actions. Meaningful momentum.</p>
                    {empty ? <p className="crm-homepage__empty">Insights will appear as your pipeline grows.</p> : <ul className="crm-homepage__list">
                      <li><span className="crm-homepage__badge crm-homepage__badge--warning">FOLLOW-UP DUE</span><h2>Keep Northstar moving</h2><p>Your $32,000 opportunity is closing in 7 days. Check in with Priya before the weekend.</p><Button variant="link-primary" onClick={() => { setAttentionOnly(true); setSelectedIds([]); }}>Review follow-up</Button></li>
                      <li><span className="crm-homepage__badge">CLOSING SOON</span><h2>Two deals, $56,500 in play</h2><p>Northstar and Meridian are due to close this month. Prioritize their next steps.</p><Button variant="link-primary" onClick={() => { setAttentionOnly(false); setSelectedIds(['northstar', 'meridian']); }}>Select closing deals</Button></li>
                    </ul>}
                  </FormSection>
                </section>
                <section className="crm-homepage__panel" aria-label="Recent chats">
                  <FormSection title="Recent chats">
                    <div className="crm-homepage__section-heading"><p>Stay close to your customers</p><span className="crm-homepage__badge" role="status">{unreadCount} unread</span></div>
                    {empty ? <p className="crm-homepage__empty">No recent conversations. Your chats will appear here.</p> : <ul className="crm-homepage__list">{CHATS.map(chat => <li key={chat.id} className="crm-homepage__chat" data-active={activeChat === chat.id || undefined}>
                      <span className="crm-homepage__initials" aria-hidden="true">{chat.initials}</span>
                      <div className="crm-homepage__chat-content"><div className="crm-homepage__section-heading"><Button variant="link-default" aria-pressed={activeChat === chat.id} onClick={() => openChat(chat.id)}>{chat.name}</Button><span className="crm-homepage__caption">{chat.time}</span></div><p>{chat.preview}</p>{chat.unread && !readChats.includes(chat.id) && <span className="crm-homepage__chat-unread">Unread</span>}</div>
                    </li>)}</ul>}

This is a local preview.`)} />
    </div>
  );
}
