        borderTop: `1px solid ${T.border}`,
        background: T.bgSurface,
        fontFamily: T.font,
      }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 24 }}>
          {[
            { icon: <WmsComment />, label: 'Chats', badge: 1 },
            { icon: <WmsZia />, label: 'Channels' },
            { icon: <WmsMotivator />, label: 'Threads' },
            { icon: <WmsReminder />, label: 'People' },
          ].map(({ icon, label, badge }) => (
            <button key={label} type="button" style={{
              display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center',
              gap: 2, background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer',
              color: T.textMuted, fontFamily: T.font, fontSize: 10, position: 'relative',
            }}>
              {icon}
              <span>{label}</span>
              {badge ? <span style={{
                position: 'absolute', top: -4, right: -8,
                background: 'var(--ds-status-error)', color: '#fff',
                borderRadius: 99, fontSize: 9, fontWeight: 700,
                minWidth: 14, height: 14, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
                padding: '0 3px',
              }}>{badge}</span> : null}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 20 }}>
          {[Settings, Bell, CalendarIcon, BentoMenu, ZiaAI].map((Icon, i) => (
            <Icon key={i} style={{ width: 16, height: 16, color: T.textMuted }} />

          <span style={{
            display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6,
            background: 'var(--ds-status-info)', color: '#fff',
            borderRadius: T.radiusMd, padding: '4px 10px',

}

function PortalCard({ children }) {

}

function PortalHeader() {

          <button type="button" style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', color: T.textBase, display: 'flex' }}>
            <ChevronDownFilled style={{ transform: 'rotate(90deg)', width: 18, height: 18 }} />

        <button type="button" style={{
          display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6,

}

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 4 }}>

}

function WizardFooter({ onPrev, onNext, onCancel, nextLabel = 'Next', prevLabel = 'Previous', showCancel = false }) {
  return (
    <div style={{
      position: 'sticky', bottom: 48,
      display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 12,
      borderTop: `1px solid ${T.border}`,
      background: T.bgSurface,
      padding: '14px 32px',
    }}>
      {showCancel && <Button variant="outline" onClick={onCancel}>Cancel</Button>}
      {onPrev && <Button variant="outline" onClick={onPrev}>{prevLabel}</Button>}
      {onNext && <Button variant="primary" onClick={onNext}>{nextLabel}</Button>}
    </div>
  );
}

function ThemePreviewMock({ layout, accent }) {

  if (layout === 'sidebar') return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', height: 144, borderRadius: T.radiusMd, border: `1px solid ${T.border}`, overflow: 'hidden', background: T.bgSubtle }}>
      <div style={{ width: '25%', padding: 12, background: accent, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>
        {[0, 1, 2].map(i => <div key={i} style={{ height: 8, borderRadius: 4, background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)' }} />)}
      </div>
      <div style={{ flex: 1, padding: 12, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>
        <div style={{ height: 12, borderRadius: 4, background: accent }} />
        <div style={{ height: 8, width: '60%', ...bar }} />
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, marginTop: 8 }}>
          <div style={{ flex: 1, height: 48, borderRadius: T.radiusMd, background: T.bgSurface }} />
          <div style={{ flex: 1, height: 48, borderRadius: T.radiusMd, background: T.bgSurface }} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
  if (layout === 'cards') return (
    <div style={{ height: 144, borderRadius: T.radiusMd, border: `1px solid ${T.border}`, overflow: 'hidden', background: T.bgSubtle, padding: 12, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>
      <div style={{ height: 12, borderRadius: 4, background: accent }} />
      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(3,1fr)', gap: 8 }}>
        {Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, i) => <div key={i} style={{ height: 40, borderRadius: T.radiusMd, background: T.bgSurface }} />)}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
  return (
    <div style={{ height: 144, borderRadius: T.radiusMd, border: `1px solid ${T.border}`, overflow: 'hidden', background: T.bgSubtle, padding: 12, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>
        <div style={{ height: 8, width: 48, borderRadius: 4, background: accent }} />
        <div style={{ height: 8, width: 40, ...bar }} />
        <div style={{ height: 8, width: 40, ...bar }} />
      </div>
      <div style={{ background: T.bgSurface, borderRadius: T.radiusMd, padding: 12, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>
        {[0, 1, 2].map(i => <div key={i} style={{ height: 8, ...bar }} />)}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ─── Story 1: Portal Experience (Step 1) ─────────────────────────────────────

              </button>
            </div>

            <div style={{ marginTop: 24 }}>
              <Stepper
                steps={[
                  { label: 'Portal Experience', state: 'active' },

              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <WizardFooter showCancel onCancel={() => {}} onNext={() => {}} nextLabel="Next" />
        </PortalCard>

        {previewTheme && (
          <div style={{ position: 'fixed', inset: 0, zIndex: 50, display: 'grid', placeItems: 'center', background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)', padding: 16 }}>
            <div style={{ width: '100%', maxWidth: 680, borderRadius: T.radiusMd, background: T.bgSurface, boxShadow: '0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)' }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', borderBottom: `1px solid ${T.border}`, padding: '16px 24px' }}>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12 }}>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: T.fontSizeBase, fontWeight: T.fontWeightSemibold, color: T.textBase }}>{previewTheme.name}</span>
                  <span style={{ background: T.bgSubtle, borderRadius: 4, padding: '2px 8px', fontSize: 11, color: T.textMuted }}>{previewTheme.tag}</span>
                </div>
                <button type="button" onClick={() => setPreviewTheme(null)} style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', color: T.textMuted }}>
                  <CloseSmall />
                </button>
              </div>
              <div style={{ padding: '20px 24px' }}>
                <ThemePreviewMock layout={previewTheme.layout} accent={previewTheme.accent} />
                <p style={{ marginTop: 16, fontSize: T.fontSizeSm, lineHeight: T.lineHeight, color: T.textMuted }}>{previewTheme.description}</p>
              </div>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 12, borderTop: `1px solid ${T.border}`, padding: '14px 24px' }}>
                <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setPreviewTheme(null)}>Close</Button>
                <Button variant="primary" onClick={() => { setTheme(previewTheme.id); setPreviewTheme(null); }}>Use this template</Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </PortalShell>
    );
  },
};

// ─── Story 3: Module Configuration (Step 3) ──────────────────────────────────

                  <tr style={{ borderBottom: `1px solid ${T.border}`, textAlign: 'left' }}>

                    ))}

                </thead>

// ─── Story 4: Field Permissions (Step 4) ─────────────────────────────────────

export const FieldPermissions = {
  name: 'Step 4 — Field Permissions',
  render: () => {
    const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('Leads');
    const [fieldState, setFieldState] = useState(
      Object.fromEntries(
        FIELD_GROUPS.flatMap((g) =>
          g.fields.map((f) => [`${g.title}:${f.label}`, { checked: f.checked, readOnly: !!f.readOnly }])
        )
      )
    );

    const toggle = (key, prop) =>
      setFieldState((s) => ({ ...s, [key]: { ...s[key], [prop]: !s[key][prop] } }));

    return (
      <PortalShell>
        <PortalCard>
          <PortalHeader />
          <div style={{ padding: '28px 32px 112px' }}>
            <h2 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 22, fontWeight: T.fontWeightSemibold, color: T.textBase }}>Portal User Group</h2>
            <p style={{ marginTop: 12, maxWidth: 700, fontSize: T.fontSizeBase, lineHeight: T.lineHeight, color: T.textLabel }}>
              Create a user group to customize and manage portal access for different users like clients, partners, vendors,
              or resellers within a domain.
            </p>

            <div style={{ marginTop: 24 }}>
              <Stepper
                steps={[
                  { label: 'Portal Experience', state: 'completed' },
                  { label: 'User Group Details', state: 'completed' },
                  { label: 'Portal Module Configuration', state: 'completed' },
                  { label: 'Field Permissions', state: 'active' },
                ]}
              />
            </div>

            <p style={{ marginTop: 32, fontSize: T.fontSizeBase, color: T.textBase }}>
              Choose the fields to be displayed for every selected tab in the{' '}
              <strong>Zylker Portal</strong> portal user group.
            </p>
            <p style={{ marginTop: 8, fontSize: T.fontSizeSm, color: T.textMuted }}>Note: Field permissions are not specific to layouts.</p>

            <div style={{ marginTop: 24 }}>
              <Tabs
                tabs={FIELD_TABS.map((t) => ({ id: t, label: t }))}
                activeTab={activeTab}
                onChange={(id) => setActiveTab(id)}
              />
            </div>

            {activeTab === 'Leads' && (
              <>
                <div style={{ marginTop: 24, display: 'inline-block', borderBottom: `2px solid ${T.accent}`, paddingBottom: 4, fontSize: T.fontSizeBase, color: T.accent, fontWeight: T.fontWeightMedium }}>Standard</div>

                <div style={{ marginTop: 24, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 24 }}>
                  {FIELD_GROUPS.map((group) => (
                    <div key={group.title}>
                      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12, background: T.bgSubtle, borderRadius: T.radiusMd, padding: '12px 16px' }}>
                        <Checkbox id={`group-${group.title}`} checked label={group.title} onChange={() => {}} />
                      </div>

                      <div style={{ marginTop: 12, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 10 }}>
                        {group.fields.map((f) => {
                          const key = `${group.title}:${f.label}`;
                          const s = fieldState[key] ?? { checked: false, readOnly: false };
                          return (
                            <div key={key} style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 200px 200px', gap: 16, alignItems: 'center', padding: '8px 16px', borderRadius: T.radiusMd, border: `1px solid ${T.border}` }}>
                              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
                                <Checkbox id={key} checked={s.checked} onChange={() => toggle(key, 'checked')} />
                                <label htmlFor={key} style={{ fontSize: T.fontSizeSm, color: T.textBase, cursor: 'pointer' }}>{f.label}</label>
                                {f.placeholder && <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: T.textMuted }}>({f.placeholder})</span>}
                              </div>
                              {f.readOnly !== undefined && f.readOnly !== null && !f.subform ? (
                                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                                  <Switch checked={s.readOnly} onChange={() => toggle(key, 'readOnly')} id={`ro-${key}`} />
                                  <label htmlFor={`ro-${key}`} style={{ fontSize: T.fontSizeSm, color: T.textLabel }}>Read Only</label>
                                </div>
                              ) : <div />}
                              {f.subform ? (
                                <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 4 }}>
                                  {['View', 'Create', 'Edit', 'Delete'].map((p) => (
                                    <span key={p} style={{ background: T.bgSubtle, borderRadius: 99, padding: '2px 8px', fontSize: 11, color: T.textLabel }}>{p}</span>
                                  ))}
                                </div>
                              ) : <div />}
                            </div>
                          );
                        })}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </>
            )}

            {activeTab !== 'Leads' && (
              <div style={{ marginTop: 32, textAlign: 'center', color: T.textMuted, fontSize: T.fontSizeSm }}>
                Select a layout from the {activeTab} module to configure field permissions.
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <WizardFooter onPrev={() => {}} onNext={() => {}} nextLabel="Save" />
        </PortalCard>
      </PortalShell>
    );
  },
};

// ─── Story 6: Users ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export const Users = {
  name: 'Users',
  render: () => {
    const [activeGroup, setActiveGroup] = useState('users');
    const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
    const [selected, setSelected] = useState({});
    const [active, setActive] = useState(
      Object.fromEntries(PORTAL_USERS.map((u) => [u.id, u.status === 'Active']))
    );
    const [reinvited, setReinvited] = useState({});

    const users = PORTAL_USERS.filter(
      (u) =>
        u.name.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()) ||
        u.email.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase())
    );

    return (
      <PortalShell>
        <PortalCard>

                <Input

                />

            <div style={{ marginTop: 20, overflowX: 'auto', borderRadius: T.radiusMd, border: `1px solid ${T.border}` }}>

                <thead>

                      <th key={h} style={{ padding: '14px 20px', fontWeight: T.fontWeightSemibold, color: T.textBase }}>{h}</th>
                    ))}
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {users.map((u, i) => (

                        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12 }}>
                          <Checkbox
                            id={`sel-${u.id}`}
                            checked={!!selected[u.id]}
                            onChange={() => setSelected((s) => ({ ...s, [u.id]: !s[u.id] }))}

                          <span style={{ color: T.textLink }}>{u.name}</span>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '14px 20px', color: T.textLink }}>{u.email}</td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '14px 20px', color: T.textLabel }}>{u.invitedOn}</td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '14px 20px', color: T.textLabel }}>{u.source}</td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '14px 20px', color: T.textLabel }}>
                        {active[u.id] ? 'Active' : u.status === 'Active' ? 'Disabled' : u.status}
                      </td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '14px 20px' }}>
                        {u.status === 'Yet to confirm' && !active[u.id] ? (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => setReinvited((r) => ({ ...r, [u.id]: true }))}
                            style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', color: T.textLink, fontSize: T.fontSizeSm }}
                          >
                            {reinvited[u.id] ? 'Invited' : 'Reinvite'}
                          </button>
                        ) : (
                          <Switch
                            checked={!!active[u.id]}
                            onChange={() => setActive((a) => ({ ...a, [u.id]: !a[u.id] }))}
                            id={`active-${u.id}`}
                          />
                        )}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                  {users.length === 0 && (
                    <tr>
                      <td colSpan={6} style={{ padding: '32px 20px', textAlign: 'center', color: T.textMuted }}>
                        No users match your search.
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  )}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
        </PortalCard>
      </PortalShell>
    );
  },

const PortalExperience = () => {
  const [step1, setStep1] = useState('systemDefinedPortal');
  const [sub, setSub] = useState('predefinedTemplates');
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState('crm-standard');
  const [previewTheme, setPreviewTheme] = useState(null);

  const step1Options = [
    { id: 'systemDefinedPortal', title: 'Default portal interface', sub: 'Experience same as CRM interface' },
    { id: 'tryNewPortalExperience', title: 'Build your Portal experience', sub: 'Pick a template, build with widgets, or use AI' },
  ];
  const subOptions = [
    { id: 'predefinedTemplates', label: 'Select Templates' },
    { id: 'buildUsingWidgets', label: 'Build using widgets' },
    { id: 'buildUsingAI', label: 'Build using AI' },

    <PortalShell>

        <PortalHeader />

            <div>
              <h2 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 22, fontWeight: T.fontWeightSemibold, color: T.textBase }}>Create Portal User Group</h2>

                vendors, or resellers within a domain. Start by choosing the portal experience you want to offer.
              </p>

            <button type="button" style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, fontSize: T.fontSizeSm, color: T.textMuted }}>
              <Info style={{ width: 16, height: 16 }} /> Help
            </button>
          </div>

          <div style={{ marginTop: 24 }}>
            <Stepper
              steps={[
                { label: 'Portal Experience', state: 'active' },
                { label: 'User Group Details', state: 'pending' },
                { label: 'Portal Module Configuration', state: 'pending' },
                { label: 'Field Permissions', state: 'pending' },
              ]}

          </div>

          <h3 style={{ marginTop: 40, marginBottom: 8, fontSize: T.fontSizeBase, fontWeight: T.fontWeightSemibold, color: T.textBase }}>Portal Experience</h3>

            Choose how the <strong style={{ color: T.textBase }}>Contact Portal</strong> looks to your portal users.
            Start with a system-defined layout, or try a new experience with templates, widgets, or AI.
          </p>

          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 16, maxWidth: 700 }}>
            {step1Options.map((opt) => {
              const active = step1 === opt.id;
              return (
                <button
                  key={opt.id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => { setStep1(opt.id); setTheme(opt.id === 'systemDefinedPortal' ? 'crm-standard' : 'aurora'); }}
                  style={{
                    display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 12,
                    padding: '16px 20px', textAlign: 'left', cursor: 'pointer',
                    fontFamily: T.font,
                    borderRadius: 12,
                    border: `2px solid ${active ? T.accent : T.border}`,
                    background: active ? `color-mix(in srgb, ${T.accent} 5%, ${T.bgSurface})` : T.bgSurface,
                    boxShadow: active ? T.shadowSm : 'none',
                  }}
                >
                  <span style={{
                    marginTop: 2, width: 20, height: 20, borderRadius: '50%',
                    border: `2px solid ${active ? T.accent : T.border}`,

                  }}>
                    {active && <span style={{ width: 10, height: 10, borderRadius: '50%', background: T.accent }} />}

                  <span>
                    <span style={{ display: 'block', fontSize: T.fontSizeBase, fontWeight: T.fontWeightSemibold, color: T.textBase }}>{opt.title}</span>
                    <span style={{ display: 'block', fontSize: T.fontSizeSm, color: T.textMuted, marginTop: 4 }}>{opt.sub}</span>
                  </span>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          {step1 === 'tryNewPortalExperience' && (
            <div style={{ marginTop: 24, marginLeft: 4, borderLeft: `2px solid color-mix(in srgb, ${T.accent} 30%, transparent)`, paddingLeft: 24 }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 12 }}>
                {subOptions.map((s) => {

                        padding: '8px 16px', cursor: 'pointer', fontFamily: T.font,
                        borderRadius: 99, fontSize: T.fontSizeSm, fontWeight: T.fontWeightSemibold,

                      }}
                    >
                      {s.label}
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          <div style={{ marginTop: 32 }}>
            <h4 style={{ marginBottom: 16, fontSize: T.fontSizeBase, fontWeight: T.fontWeightSemibold, color: T.textBase }}>
              {step1 === 'systemDefinedPortal' ? 'Default portal interface' : 'Predefined portal interface'}
            </h4>
            <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: step1 === 'systemDefinedPortal' ? '1fr' : '1fr 1fr', gap: 16, maxWidth: step1 === 'systemDefinedPortal' ? 360 : 680 }}>
              {themes.map((t) => {
                const selected = theme === t.id;
                return (
                  <div
                    key={t.id}
                    style={{
                      padding: 12, borderRadius: T.radiusMd,
                      border: `1px solid ${selected ? T.accent : T.border}`,
                      boxShadow: selected ? `0 0 0 1px ${T.accent}` : 'none',
                    }}
                  >
                    <ThemePreviewMock layout={t.layout} accent={t.accent} />
                    <div style={{ marginTop: 12, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
                      <span style={{ fontSize: T.fontSizeSm, fontWeight: T.fontWeightSemibold, color: T.textBase }}>{t.name}</span>
                      <span style={{ background: T.bgSubtle, borderRadius: 4, padding: '2px 8px', fontSize: 11, color: T.textMuted }}>{t.tag}</span>
                    </div>
                    <p style={{ margin: '6px 0 12px', fontSize: 12, lineHeight: T.lineHeight, color: T.textMuted }}>{t.description}</p>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>
                      <Button variant={selected ? 'primary' : 'outline'} onClick={() => setTheme(t.id)}>
                        {selected ? 'Selected' : 'Select'}
                      </Button>
                      <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setPreviewTheme(t)}>Preview</Button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <WizardFooter showCancel onCancel={() => {}} onNext={() => {}} nextLabel="Next" />
      </PortalCard>

      {previewTheme && (
        <div style={{ position: 'fixed', inset: 0, zIndex: 50, display: 'grid', placeItems: 'center', background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)', padding: 16 }}>
          <div style={{ width: '100%', maxWidth: 680, borderRadius: T.radiusMd, background: T.bgSurface, boxShadow: '0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)' }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', borderBottom: `1px solid ${T.border}`, padding: '16px 24px' }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12 }}>
                <span style={{ fontSize: T.fontSizeBase, fontWeight: T.fontWeightSemibold, color: T.textBase }}>{previewTheme.name}</span>
                <span style={{ background: T.bgSubtle, borderRadius: 4, padding: '2px 8px', fontSize: 11, color: T.textMuted }}>{previewTheme.tag}</span>
              </div>
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setPreviewTheme(null)} style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', color: T.textMuted }}>
                <CloseSmall />
              </button>
            </div>
            <div style={{ padding: '20px 24px' }}>
              <ThemePreviewMock layout={previewTheme.layout} accent={previewTheme.accent} />
              <p style={{ marginTop: 16, fontSize: T.fontSizeSm, lineHeight: T.lineHeight, color: T.textMuted }}>{previewTheme.description}</p>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 12, borderTop: `1px solid ${T.border}`, padding: '14px 24px' }}>
              <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setPreviewTheme(null)}>Close</Button>
              <Button variant="primary" onClick={() => { setTheme(previewTheme.id); setPreviewTheme(null); }}>Use this template</Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </PortalShell>
  );
};

const ModuleConfiguration = () => {

  const toggle = (key) => setLayouts((s) => ({ ...s, [key]: !s[key] }));

const FieldPermissions = () => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('Leads');
  const [fieldState, setFieldState] = useState(
    Object.fromEntries(
      FIELD_GROUPS.flatMap((g) =>
        g.fields.map((f) => [`${g.title}:${f.label}`, { checked: f.checked, readOnly: !!f.readOnly }])
      )
    )
  );

  const toggle = (key, prop) =>
    setFieldState((s) => ({ ...s, [key]: { ...s[key], [prop]: !s[key][prop] } }));

  return (
    <PortalShell>
      <PortalCard>
        <PortalHeader />
        <div style={{ padding: '28px 32px 112px' }}>
          <h2 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 22, fontWeight: T.fontWeightSemibold, color: T.textBase }}>Portal User Group</h2>
          <p style={{ marginTop: 12, maxWidth: 700, fontSize: T.fontSizeBase, lineHeight: T.lineHeight, color: T.textLabel }}>
            Create a user group to customize and manage portal access for different users like clients, partners, vendors,
            or resellers within a domain.
          </p>

          <div style={{ marginTop: 24 }}>
            <Stepper
              steps={[
                { label: 'Portal Experience', state: 'completed' },
                { label: 'User Group Details', state: 'completed' },
                { label: 'Portal Module Configuration', state: 'completed' },
                { label: 'Field Permissions', state: 'active' },
              ]}
            />
          </div>

          <p style={{ marginTop: 32, fontSize: T.fontSizeBase, color: T.textBase }}>
            Choose the fields to be displayed for every selected tab in the{' '}
            <strong>Zylker Portal</strong> portal user group.
          </p>
          <p style={{ marginTop: 8, fontSize: T.fontSizeSm, color: T.textMuted }}>Note: Field permissions are not specific to layouts.</p>

          <div style={{ marginTop: 24 }}>
            <Tabs
              tabs={FIELD_TABS.map((t) => ({ id: t, label: t }))}
              activeTab={activeTab}
              onChange={(id) => setActiveTab(id)}
            />
          </div>

          {activeTab === 'Leads' && (
            <>
              <div style={{ marginTop: 24, display: 'inline-block', borderBottom: `2px solid ${T.accent}`, paddingBottom: 4, fontSize: T.fontSizeBase, color: T.accent, fontWeight: T.fontWeightMedium }}>Standard</div>

              <div style={{ marginTop: 24, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 24 }}>
                {FIELD_GROUPS.map((group) => (
                  <div key={group.title}>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12, background: T.bgSubtle, borderRadius: T.radiusMd, padding: '12px 16px' }}>
                      <Checkbox id={`group-${group.title}`} checked label={group.title} onChange={() => {}} />
                    </div>

                    <div style={{ marginTop: 12, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 10 }}>
                      {group.fields.map((f) => {
                        const key = `${group.title}:${f.label}`;
                        const s = fieldState[key] ?? { checked: false, readOnly: false };
                        return (
                          <div key={key} style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 200px 200px', gap: 16, alignItems: 'center', padding: '8px 16px', borderRadius: T.radiusMd, border: `1px solid ${T.border}` }}>
                            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
                              <Checkbox id={key} checked={s.checked} onChange={() => toggle(key, 'checked')} />
                              <label htmlFor={key} style={{ fontSize: T.fontSizeSm, color: T.textBase, cursor: 'pointer' }}>{f.label}</label>
                              {f.placeholder && <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: T.textMuted }}>({f.placeholder})</span>}
                            </div>
                            {f.readOnly !== undefined && f.readOnly !== null && !f.subform ? (
                              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                                <Switch checked={s.readOnly} onChange={() => toggle(key, 'readOnly')} id={`ro-${key}`} />
                                <label htmlFor={`ro-${key}`} style={{ fontSize: T.fontSizeSm, color: T.textLabel }}>Read Only</label>
                              </div>
                            ) : <div />}
                            {f.subform ? (
                              <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 4 }}>
                                {['View', 'Create', 'Edit', 'Delete'].map((p) => (
                                  <span key={p} style={{ background: T.bgSubtle, borderRadius: 99, padding: '2px 8px', fontSize: 11, color: T.textLabel }}>{p}</span>
                                ))}
                              </div>
                            ) : <div />}
                          </div>
                        );
                      })}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </>
          )}

          {activeTab !== 'Leads' && (
            <div style={{ marginTop: 32, textAlign: 'center', color: T.textMuted, fontSize: T.fontSizeSm }}>
              Select a layout from the {activeTab} module to configure field permissions.
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        <WizardFooter onPrev={() => {}} onNext={() => {}} nextLabel="Save" />
      </PortalCard>
    </PortalShell>
  );
};

const Users = () => {
  const [activeGroup, setActiveGroup] = useState('users');
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState({});
  const [active, setActive] = useState(
    Object.fromEntries(PORTAL_USERS.map((u) => [u.id, u.status === 'Active']))
  );
  const [reinvited, setReinvited] = useState({});

  const users = PORTAL_USERS.filter(
    (u) =>
      u.name.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()) ||
      u.email.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase())
  );

  return (
    <PortalShell>
      <PortalCard>
        <GroupHeader active={activeGroup} onTabChange={setActiveGroup} />
        <div style={{ padding: '28px 32px 112px' }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12 }}>
              <Button variant="outline">All Users ({PORTAL_USERS.length}) ▾</Button>
              <Input
                layout="vertical"
                placeholder="Search Users"
                value={query}
                onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
                width={220}
                suffix={<Search style={{ width: 14, height: 14, color: 'var(--ds-text-muted)' }} />}
              />
            </div>
            <Button variant="outline">Invite users</Button>
          </div>

          <div style={{ marginTop: 20, overflowX: 'auto', borderRadius: T.radiusMd, border: `1px solid ${T.border}` }}>
            <table style={{ width: '100%', minWidth: 900, borderCollapse: 'collapse', fontSize: T.fontSizeSm, fontFamily: T.font }}>
              <thead>
                <tr style={{ borderBottom: `1px solid ${T.border}`, textAlign: 'left' }}>
                  {['Portal User Name ▾', 'Email Id', 'Invited/Submitted On ▾', 'All Source ▾', 'Portal User Status', 'Actions'].map((h) => (
                    <th key={h} style={{ padding: '14px 20px', fontWeight: T.fontWeightSemibold, color: T.textBase }}>{h}</th>
                  ))}
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {users.map((u, i) => (
                  <tr key={u.id} style={{ borderBottom: i < users.length - 1 ? `1px solid ${T.border}` : 'none' }}>
                    <td style={{ padding: '14px 20px' }}>
                      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12 }}>
                        <Checkbox
                          id={`sel-${u.id}`}
                          checked={!!selected[u.id]}
                          onChange={() => setSelected((s) => ({ ...s, [u.id]: !s[u.id] }))}
                        />
                        <span style={{ color: T.textLink }}>{u.name}</span>
                      </div>
                    </td>
                    <td style={{ padding: '14px 20px', color: T.textLink }}>{u.email}</td>
                    <td style={{ padding: '14px 20px', color: T.textLabel }}>{u.invitedOn}</td>
                    <td style={{ padding: '14px 20px', color: T.textLabel }}>{u.source}</td>
                    <td style={{ padding: '14px 20px', color: T.textLabel }}>
                      {active[u.id] ? 'Active' : u.status === 'Active' ? 'Disabled' : u.status}
                    </td>
                    <td style={{ padding: '14px 20px' }}>
                      {u.status === 'Yet to confirm' && !active[u.id] ? (
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setReinvited((r) => ({ ...r, [u.id]: true }))}
                          style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', color: T.textLink, fontSize: T.fontSizeSm }}
                        >
                          {reinvited[u.id] ? 'Invited' : 'Reinvite'}
                        </button>
                      ) : (
                        <Switch
                          checked={!!active[u.id]}
                          onChange={() => setActive((a) => ({ ...a, [u.id]: !a[u.id] }))}
                          id={`active-${u.id}`}
                        />
                      )}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
                {users.length === 0 && (
                  <tr>
                    <td colSpan={6} style={{ padding: '32px 20px', textAlign: 'center', color: T.textMuted }}>
                      No users match your search.
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                )}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
      </PortalCard>
    </PortalShell>
  );
};

type SavedSettings = Partial<Record<Channel, VerificationConfig>>;
type PageProps = { initial?: 'empty' | 'phone' | 'both'; dialog?: Channel; expanded?: boolean; configuration?: boolean };
type Preview = { title: string; content: string; kind?: 'email' | 'page' };
type TemplateSettings = { subject: string; sender: string; body: string };
const DEFAULT_SUBJECT = 'Verify your email address with ${Organization.OrganizationName}';
function templateDefaults(kind: 'email' | 'page', validity = '7'): TemplateSettings {
  return {
    sender: 'owner', subject: DEFAULT_SUBJECT,
    body: kind === 'email'
      ? `Hello \${Contacts.FullName},\n\nPlease verify your email address with \${Organization.OrganizationName}. To confirm your email address, please click on the button below. This link expires in ${validity} day(s).\n\n[Verify email address]\n\nIf you did not request this verification, please ignore this email.\n\nRegards,\n\${Organization.OrganizationName}`
      : 'Email address verified\n\nThank you for confirming your email address. You can now close this page.',
  };
}

// Figma 54195:187585: shared template-modal composition of existing primitives.
function TemplateDialog({ kind, initial, validity, onClose, onSave, readOnly = false }: {
  kind: 'email' | 'page'; initial?: TemplateSettings; validity?: string; readOnly?: boolean;
  onClose: () => void; onSave?: (settings: TemplateSettings) => void;
}) {
  const [settings, setSettings] = useState(() => initial ?? templateDefaults(kind, validity));
  const [language, setLanguage] = useState('en-US');
  const [editorContent, setEditorContent] = useState(settings.body);
  const [editorKey, setEditorKey] = useState(0);
  const reset = () => {
    const defaults = templateDefaults(kind, validity);
    setSettings(defaults); setEditorContent(defaults.body); setEditorKey(key => key + 1);
  };
  return <Modal isOpen title={readOnly ? (kind === 'email' ? 'Verification Link Email Preview' : 'Verification Page Preview') : (kind === 'email' ? 'Edit Email Content' : 'Edit Verification Page')} width={865}
    className={`record-auth-template-modal${readOnly ? ' record-auth-preview-modal' : ''}`} disableAutoFocus
    showFooter={!readOnly} showClose={readOnly} closeLabel="Close preview"
    headerActions={!readOnly && kind === 'email' ? <Dropdown aria-label="Template language" width="fit-content" value={language} onChange={setLanguage}
      panelStyle={{ width: 'max-content', maxWidth: 'calc(100vw - 24px)' }}
      options={[
        { value: 'en-US', label: 'English (United States)' },
        { value: 'en-GB', label: 'English (United Kingdom)' },
        { value: 'fr', label: 'French' }, { value: 'de', label: 'German' },
        { value: 'es', label: 'Spanish' }, { value: 'it', label: 'Italian' },
        { value: 'pt', label: 'Portuguese' }, { value: 'nl', label: 'Dutch' },
        { value: 'ja', label: 'Japanese' }, { value: 'zh', label: 'Chinese (Simplified)' },
        { value: 'hi', label: 'Hindi' }, { value: 'ta', label: 'Tamil' },
      ]} /> : undefined}
    footerStart={<Button variant="ghost-blue" onClick={reset}>Reset to default</Button>}
    onClose={onClose} onSave={() => onSave?.(settings)}>
    <div className={`record-auth-template${kind === 'page' ? ' record-auth-template--page' : ''}`}>
      {readOnly && kind === 'email' && <dl className="record-auth-preview__fields">
        <dt>From</dt><dd>{settings.sender === 'organization' ? 'Organization Email' : 'Record Owner’s Email'}</dd>
        <dt>Subject</dt><dd>{settings.subject}</dd>
      </dl>}
      {!readOnly && kind === 'email' && <div className="record-auth-template__fields">
        <Dropdown label="From" aria-label="From" width="100%" value={settings.sender}
          options={[{ value: 'owner', label: 'Record Owner’s Email' }, { value: 'organization', label: 'Organization Email' }]}
          onChange={(sender: string) => setSettings(current => ({ ...current, sender }))} />
        <Input label="Subject" width="100%" value={settings.subject}
          onChange={(event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => setSettings(current => ({ ...current, subject: event.target.value }))} />
      </div>}
      {readOnly ? <div className="rte-field"><div className="rte-editor-wrap">
        <div className="rte-editor" role="region" aria-label={kind === 'email' ? 'Email template preview' : 'Verification page preview'}>
          {kind === 'email' ? settings.body.split('[Verify email address]').map((part, index) => <span key={index}>
            {index > 0 && <span className="record-auth-preview__verify">Verify email address</span>}{part}
          </span>) : <>
            <h2>{settings.body.split('\n\n')[0]}</h2>
            {settings.body.split('\n\n').slice(1).map((paragraph, index) => <p key={index}>{paragraph}</p>)}
          </>}
        </div>
      </div></div> : <RichTextEditor key={editorKey} width="100%" minHeight={kind === 'page' ? 0 : 380} alwaysShowToolbar toolbarPosition="top" showExpand={false}
        aria-label={kind === 'email' ? 'Email template body' : 'Verification page body'} initialContent={kind === 'email' ? editorContent.split('[Verify email address]').map((part, index) => (
          <span key={index}>{index > 0 && <span contentEditable={false}>
            <Button variant="primary" className="record-auth-template__verify">Verify email address</Button>
          </span>}{part}</span>
        )) : <>
          <h2>{editorContent.split('\n\n')[0]}</h2>
          {editorContent.split('\n\n').slice(1).map((paragraph, index) => <p key={index}>{paragraph}</p>)}
        </>}
        onChange={(body: string) => setSettings(current => ({ ...current,
          body: kind === 'email' ? body.replace(/(?<!\[)Verify email address(?!\])/g, '[Verify email address]') : body,
        }))} />}
    </div>
  </Modal>;
}

// Story-local layout compositions, using the existing design-system primitives.
function FormRow({ label, children }: { label: string; children: ReactNode }) {
  return <div className="record-auth-form__row"><span className="record-auth-form__label">{label}</span><div>{children}</div></div>;
}

function VerificationDialog({ channel, initial, expanded, onClose, onSave, method, lead, onBack }: {
  channel: Channel; initial: VerificationConfig; expanded: boolean;
  method?: ConfirmationMethod; lead?: ReactNode; onBack?: (config: VerificationConfig) => void;
  onClose: () => void; onSave: (config: VerificationConfig) => void;
}) {
  const id = useId();
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<VerificationConfig>(() => ({ ...initial, fields: [...initial.fields] }));
  const [more, setMore] = useState(expanded);
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState<Preview>();
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Partial<Record<keyof VerificationConfig, string>>>({});
  const phone = channel === 'phone';
  const code = method === 'code';
  const usesCode = phone || code;
  const update = <K extends keyof VerificationConfig>(key: K, value: VerificationConfig[K]) => {
    setDraft(current => ({ ...current, [key]: value }));
    setErrors(current => ({ ...current, [key]: undefined }));
  };
  const fieldError = (key: keyof VerificationConfig) => errors[key] ? (
    <p id={`${id}-${key}-error`} className="record-auth-form__error" role="alert">{errors[key]}</p>
  ) : null;
  const save = () => {
    const next: Partial<Record<keyof VerificationConfig, string>> = {};
    const numberKeys = ['validity', 'resendAttempts', 'resetAfter',
      ...(usesCode ? ['validationAttempts', 'validationReset'] as const : [])] as const;
    if (!draft.fields.length) next.fields = 'Select at least one field to verify.';
    const numberLabels = {
      validity: usesCode ? 'OTP Validity' : 'Verification Link Validity',
      resendAttempts: 'Max Resend Attempts',
      resetAfter: 'Reset Resend Attempt After',
      validationAttempts: 'Max Validation Attempts',
      validationReset: 'Reset Validation Attempt After',
    };
    for (const key of numberKeys) {
      const value = draft[key];
      if (!value.trim()) {
        next[key] = `${numberLabels[key]} cannot be empty`;
      } else if (!/^\d+$/.test(value) || !Number.isSafeInteger(Number(value)) || Number(value) < 1) {
        next[key] = `${numberLabels[key]} must be a positive whole number`;
      }
    }
    if (phone && !draft.carrier) next.carrier = 'Select an SMS carrier.';
    if (phone && (!draft.template.trim() || draft.template.length > 160 || !draft.template.includes('${OTP}'))) {
      next.template = 'Enter an SMS template of up to 160 characters containing ${OTP}.';
    }
    setErrors(next);
    if (Object.keys(next).length) {
      if (next.resendAttempts || next.resetAfter || next.validationAttempts || next.validationReset) setMore(true);
      return;
    }
    onSave(draft);
  };
  const numberInput = (key: 'validity' | 'resendAttempts' | 'resetAfter' | 'validationAttempts' | 'validationReset', label: string, suffix?: string) => (
    <div>
      <div className="record-auth-form__number">
        <Input type="number" aria-label={label} error={!!errors[key]} aria-invalid={!!errors[key]}
          aria-describedby={[suffix && `${id}-${key}-unit`, errors[key] && `${id}-${key}-error`].filter(Boolean).join(' ') || undefined}
          min={1} step={1} width="100%" value={draft[key]}
          onChange={(event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => update(key, event.target.value)} />
        {suffix && <span id={`${id}-${key}-unit`}>{suffix === 'Minutes' ? 'Minute(s)' : suffix}</span>}
      </div>
      {fieldError(key)}
    </div>
  );
  return <><Modal isOpen title={method ? `Record Verification via ${phone ? 'OTP on Phone' : code ? 'Code on Email' : 'Confirmation Link'}` : `Data Verification via ${phone ? 'Phone Number' : 'Email Address'}`}
    className="record-auth-config-modal" width={670} onClose={onClose} onSave={save}
    footerStart={onBack ? <Button onClick={() => onBack(draft)}>Back</Button> : undefined}>
    <div className="record-auth-form">
      {lead}
      {!method && <><FormRow label="Fields"><div role="group" aria-label="Fields to verify" aria-invalid={!!errors.fields} aria-describedby={errors.fields ? `${id}-fields-error` : undefined}>
        <Tags value={draft.fields} options={phone ? PHONE_FIELDS : EMAIL_FIELDS} placeholder="Add"
          onChange={(fields: Field[]) => update('fields', fields)} width="100%" />
        {fieldError('fields')}
      </div></FormRow>
      <Checkbox label={`Restrict outgoing ${phone ? 'calls' : 'emails'} until verified`} checked={draft.restrict}
        onChange={(event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => update('restrict', event.target.checked)} /></>}
      <section className="record-auth-form__section" aria-labelledby={`${id}-settings`}>
        <h2 id={`${id}-settings`}>{usesCode ? (code ? 'Email Code Configuration' : 'OTP Configuration') : 'Verification Link Configuration'}</h2>
        {usesCode && <FormRow label="OTP Length"><div className="record-auth-form__inline" role="radiogroup" aria-label="OTP Length">
          {(['6', '4'] as const).map(digits => <Radio key={digits} label={`${digits} Digits`} name={`${id}-digits`}
            checked={draft.digits === digits} onChange={() => update('digits', digits)} />)}
        </div></FormRow>}
        <FormRow label={usesCode ? 'Valid for' : 'Verification Link Validity'}>
          {numberInput('validity', usesCode ? 'OTP validity' : 'Verification link validity', usesCode ? 'Minutes' : 'Day(s)')}
        </FormRow>
        {phone ? <>
          <FormRow label="SMS Carrier">
            <div role="group" aria-label="SMS carrier selection" aria-invalid={!!errors.carrier}
              aria-describedby={errors.carrier ? `${id}-carrier-error` : undefined}>
              <Dropdown aria-label="SMS Carrier" width="100%" value={draft.carrier}
                options={CARRIERS} onChange={(value: string) => update('carrier', value)} />
              {fieldError('carrier')}
            </div>
          </FormRow>
          <div className="record-auth-form__row record-auth-form__template-row">
            <label className="record-auth-form__label" htmlFor={`${id}-sms-template`}>SMS Template</label>
            <div>
              <Textarea id={`${id}-sms-template`} error={!!errors.template} aria-invalid={!!errors.template}
                aria-describedby={`${id}-sms-hint${errors.template ? ` ${id}-template-error` : ''}`} width="100%" minHeight={90} maxLength={160} value={draft.template}
                onChange={(event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => update('template', event.target.value)} />
              {fieldError('template')}
              <div className="record-auth-form__count">
                <span id={`${id}-sms-hint`}>Type # to insert merge field</span><span>{draft.template.length}/160</span>
              </div>
              <div className="record-auth-form__preview" role="region" aria-label="SMS Preview"><strong>SMS Preview</strong><p>{smsPreview(draft)}</p></div>
              <Button variant="link-primary" size="sm">Send Text SMS</Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </> : <>
          <FormRow label="Email Content">
            <button type="button" className="record-auth-form__template-input" aria-haspopup="dialog"
              onClick={() => setPreview({ title: 'Email Content', content: '', kind: 'email' })}>
              <span>{EMAIL_TEMPLATES.find(template => template.value === draft.emailTemplate)?.label}</span>
              <Icon name="CrmEditFilledMd" size={12} />
            </button>
          </FormRow>
          {!code && <FormRow label="Verification Page">
            <button type="button" className="record-auth-form__template-input" aria-haspopup="dialog"
              onClick={() => setPreview({ title: 'Verification Page', content: '', kind: 'page' })}>
              <span>{VERIFICATION_PAGES.find(page => page.value === draft.verificationPage)?.label}</span>
              <Icon name="CrmEditFilledMd" size={12} />
            </button>
          </FormRow>}
        </>}
      </section>
      {!more && <div><Button variant="link-primary" aria-expanded={more} aria-controls={`${id}-more`}
        onClick={() => setMore(true)}>More Options</Button></div>}
      {more && <div id={`${id}-more`} className="record-auth-form__options">
        <section className="record-auth-form__section" aria-labelledby={`${id}-resend`}>
          <h2 id={`${id}-resend`}>Resend Options</h2>
          {usesCode && <FormRow label="OTP Resend">
            <Dropdown aria-label="OTP Resend" width="100%" options={RESEND_MODES}
              value={draft.resendMode} onChange={(value: string) => update('resendMode', value)} />
          </FormRow>}
          <FormRow label="Max Resend Attempts">{numberInput('resendAttempts', 'Max Resend Attempts')}</FormRow>
          <FormRow label="Reset Attempt After">{numberInput('resetAfter', 'Reset resend attempt after', usesCode ? 'Minutes' : 'Hour(s)')}</FormRow>
        </section>
        {usesCode && <section className="record-auth-form__section" aria-labelledby={`${id}-validation`}>
          <h2 id={`${id}-validation`}>Validation Options</h2>
          <FormRow label="Max Validation Attempts">{numberInput('validationAttempts', 'Max Validation Attempts')}</FormRow>
          <FormRow label="Reset Attempt After">{numberInput('validationReset', 'Reset validation attempt after', 'Hour(s)')}</FormRow>
        </section>}
      </div>}
      {!usesCode && <MessageInfo variant="info" message="A new send invalidates the previous link. Latest request wins." />}
    </div>
  </Modal>
    {preview?.kind && <TemplateDialog kind={preview.kind} validity={draft.validity}
      initial={preview.kind === 'email' ? draft.emailContent : draft.pageContent}
      onClose={() => setPreview(undefined)} onSave={settings => {
        update(preview.kind === 'email' ? 'emailContent' : 'pageContent', settings);
        setPreview(undefined);
      }} />}
  </>;
}

function VerificationSummary({ channel, config, onEdit, onPreview }: {
  channel: Channel; config: VerificationConfig; onEdit: () => void; onPreview: (preview: Preview) => void;
}) {
  const phone = channel === 'phone';
  const iconName = phone ? 'CrmMobile' : 'CrmBestTimeToEmailPlayBooks';
  const SummaryIcon = crmIconMap[iconName];
  const iconDimensions = crmIconMetadata[iconName];
  const title = phone ? 'OTP Configuration for Phone Number Verification' : 'Verification Link for Email Address Verification';
  const emailName = EMAIL_TEMPLATES.find(template => template.value === config.emailTemplate)?.label;
  const pageName = VERIFICATION_PAGES.find(page => page.value === config.verificationPage)?.label;
  return <section className="record-auth__summary" aria-label={title}>
    <div className="record-auth__summary-title"><h2><SummaryIcon width={iconDimensions.width} height={iconDimensions.height} aria-hidden="true" />{title}</h2><Button variant="link-primary" size="sm"
      aria-label={`Edit ${phone ? 'phone' : 'email'} verification`} onClick={onEdit}>Edit</Button></div>
    <div className="record-auth__summary-card">
      <p>{phone ? `${config.digits} Digit OTP - Valid for ${config.validity} minutes` : `Link valid for ${config.validity} days`}</p>
      <dl>
        <dt>Resend:</dt><dd>{config.resendAttempts} attempts, Reset after {config.resetAfter} {phone ? 'minutes' : 'hours'}</dd>
        {phone && <><dt>Validation:</dt><dd>{config.validationAttempts} attempts, Reset after {config.validationReset} {config.validationReset === '1' ? 'hour' : 'hours'}</dd></>}
      </dl>
      <div className="record-auth__links">{phone ? <Button variant="link-primary" onClick={() => onPreview({ title: 'SMS Template Preview', content: config.template })}>SMS Template</Button> : <>
        <Button variant="link-primary" onClick={() => onPreview({ title: emailName ?? 'Email Content', content: '', kind: 'email' })}>Verification Link Email</Button>
        <span className="record-auth__link-separator" aria-hidden="true" />
        <Button variant="link-primary" onClick={() => onPreview({ title: pageName ?? 'Verification Page', content: '', kind: 'page' })}>Verification Page</Button>
      </>}</div>
    </div>
  </section>;
}

function RecordAuthenticationPage({ initial = 'empty', dialog, expanded = false, configuration = false }: PageProps) {
  const id = useId();
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState(configuration ? 'configuration' : 'verification');
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState<SavedSettings>(() => initial === 'empty' ? {} : {
    phone: { ...defaultConfig('phone'), carrier: 'twilio' },
    ...(initial === 'both' ? { email: defaultConfig('email') } : {}),
  });
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<Channel | undefined>(dialog);
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState<Preview | undefined>();
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<{ message: string }>();
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!notice) return;
    const timeout = window.setTimeout(() => setNotice(undefined), 5000);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timeout);
  }, [notice]);
  const [sidebarId, setSidebarId] = useState('modules-fields');
  const configured = !!saved.phone || !!saved.email;
  const availableChannels = VERIFICATION_CHANNELS.filter(option => !saved[option.value as Channel]);
  return <div className="record-auth">
    <header><NextGenTopBand moduleLabel={null} showTerritory={false} /></header>
    <div className="record-auth__shell">
      <aside className="record-auth__sidebar" aria-label="Setup navigation"><VerticalTabs variant="setup" searchable
        width="100%" items={SETUP_ITEMS} activeId={sidebarId} onSelect={setSidebarId} /></aside>
      <main className="record-auth__workspace" aria-label="Record Authentication">
        <div className="record-auth__module-title">
          <svg width="14.5" height="12" viewBox="0 0 14.5 12" fill="none" aria-hidden="true">
            <path d="M6 1 1 6l5 5M1 6h12.5" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
          </svg>
          <h1>Contacts<svg width="9" height="5" viewBox="0 0 9 5" aria-hidden="true">
            <path d="M0 0h9L4.5 5Z" fill="currentColor" />
          </svg></h1>
        </div>
        <nav className="record-auth__module-tabs" aria-label="Contacts settings">{MODULE_TABS.map(tab =>
          <span key={tab} aria-current={tab === 'Record Authentication' ? 'page' : undefined}>{tab}</span>)}</nav>
        <div className="record-auth__content">
          <Tabs tabs={FEATURE_TABS} activeTab={activeTab} onChange={setActiveTab} variant="secondary" />
          <div className="record-auth__panel" role="tabpanel" aria-label={activeTab === 'verification' ? 'Data Verification' : 'Record Verification'}>
            {activeTab === 'verification' && <>
              <div className="record-auth__intro"><p>Verify that phone numbers and email addresses belong to the contact.</p>
                {configured && availableChannels.length > 0 && <Dropdown id={`${id}-verify`} width="fit-content" placeholder="Verify via" value="" triggerButtonVariant="primary"
                  panelStyle={{ width: 'max-content', maxWidth: 'calc(100vw - 24px)' }}
                  options={availableChannels}
                  onChange={(value: string) => setEditing(value as Channel)} />}
              </div>
              {!configured && <Dropdown id={`${id}-verify`} width={180} placeholder="Verify via" value="" triggerButtonVariant="primary"
                panelStyle={{ width: 'max-content', maxWidth: 'calc(100vw - 24px)' }}
                  options={availableChannels}
                onChange={(value: string) => setEditing(value as Channel)} />}
              {(['phone', 'email'] as const).map(channel => saved[channel] && <VerificationSummary key={channel}
                channel={channel} config={saved[channel]} onEdit={() => setEditing(channel)} onPreview={setPreview} />)}
            </>}
            <div hidden={activeTab !== 'configuration'}><RecordVerification onNotice={message => setNotice({ message })}
              renderSettings={({ method, initial, lead, onBack, onClose, onSave }) => <VerificationDialog
                key={method} channel={method === 'otp' ? 'phone' : 'email'} method={method}
                initial={initial} expanded={false} lead={lead} onBack={onBack} onClose={onClose} onSave={onSave} />} /></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </main>
    </div>
    <footer className="record-auth__wms" aria-label="Communication bar"><WMSBar /></footer>
    {notice && <MessageBox className="record-auth__notice" variant="success" message={notice.message}
      onClose={() => setNotice(undefined)} />}
    {editing && <VerificationDialog key={editing} channel={editing} initial={saved[editing] ?? defaultConfig(editing)} expanded={expanded}
      onClose={() => setEditing(undefined)} onSave={config => {
        setSaved(current => ({ ...current, [editing]: config }));
        setNotice({ message: `${editing === 'phone' ? 'Phone Number' : 'Email Address'} verification configured successfully` });
        setEditing(undefined);
      }} />}
    {preview?.kind && <TemplateDialog kind={preview.kind} validity={saved.email?.validity} readOnly
      initial={preview.kind === 'email' ? saved.email?.emailContent : saved.email?.pageContent}
      onClose={() => setPreview(undefined)} />}
    {preview && !preview.kind && <Modal isOpen title={preview.title} width={620}
      className="record-auth-preview-modal" showFooter={false} disableAutoFocus
      showClose closeLabel="Close preview" onClose={() => setPreview(undefined)}>
      <div className="record-auth-form"><p className="record-auth-form__template">{preview.content}</p></div>
    </Modal>}
  </div>;
}

const meta = {
  title: 'Design System/Patterns/Record Authentication',
  parameters: { layout: 'fullscreen', docs: { description: { component: 'Data Verification configuration based on the six provided PDF frames. Phone OTP, email verification links, template previews, and in-memory saved summaries. Record Verification follows the PM mock with action, method, and delivery configuration steps. No real SMS, email, or authentication requests are made.' } } },
} satisfies Meta;
export default meta;
type Story = StoryObj<typeof meta>;

export const Default: Story = {
  render: () => <RecordAuthenticationPage />,
  play: async ({ canvasElement }) => {
    const canvas = within(canvasElement);
    const body = within(canvasElement.ownerDocument.body);
    await expect(canvasElement.querySelector('.ngtb-badge')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    await expect(within(canvas.getByRole('button', { name: 'User profile' })).getByRole('img', { name: 'User' })).toHaveAttribute('src', `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}images/avatars/user_06.jpg`);
    const verifyButton = canvas.getByRole('button', { name: 'Verify via' });
    await expect(verifyButton).toHaveAttribute('data-variant', 'primary');
    await userEvent.click(verifyButton);
    for (const name of ['Phone Number', 'Email Address']) {
      await expect(body.getByRole('option', { name }).querySelector('.dropdown-option-icon svg')).toBeInTheDocument();
    }
    await userEvent.click(body.getByRole('option', { name: 'Phone Number' }));
    const dialog = await body.findByRole('dialog');
    await waitFor(() => expect(within(dialog).getByText('Data Verification via Phone Number')).toBeVisible());
    await userEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole('button', { name: 'Cancel' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(body.queryByRole('dialog')).not.toBeInTheDocument());
    await expect(canvas.queryByRole('region', { name: 'OTP Configuration for Phone Number Verification' })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    await userEvent.click(canvas.getByRole('tab', { name: 'Record Verification' }));
    await expect(canvas.getByRole('heading', { name: 'No record verification configured' })).toBeVisible();
    await userEvent.click(canvas.getByRole('tab', { name: 'Data Verification' }));
  },
};
export const PhoneVerification: Story = { render: () => <RecordAuthenticationPage dialog="phone" /> };
export const PhoneMoreOptions: Story = {
  render: () => <RecordAuthenticationPage dialog="phone" expanded />,
  play: async ({ canvasElement }) => {
    const form = within(await within(canvasElement.ownerDocument.body).findByRole('dialog'));
    const attempts = form.getByRole('spinbutton', { name: 'Max Resend Attempts' });
    await userEvent.clear(attempts);
    await userEvent.click(form.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save' }));
    await expect(attempts).toHaveAccessibleDescription('Max Resend Attempts cannot be empty');
    await userEvent.type(attempts, '0');
    await userEvent.click(form.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save' }));
    await expect(attempts).toHaveAccessibleDescription('Max Resend Attempts must be a positive whole number');
    await userEvent.clear(attempts);
    await userEvent.type(attempts, '5');
    await expect(attempts).not.toHaveAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
  },
};
export const EmailVerification: Story = {
  render: () => <RecordAuthenticationPage dialog="email" />,
  play: async ({ canvasElement }) => {
    const canvas = within(canvasElement);
    const body = within(canvasElement.ownerDocument.body);
    const form = within(await body.findByRole('dialog'));
    await expect(form.queryByRole('heading', { name: 'Resend Options' })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    await userEvent.click(form.getByRole('button', { name: 'More Options' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(form.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Resend Options' })).toBeVisible());
    const resendAttempts = form.getByRole('spinbutton', { name: 'Max Resend Attempts' });
    await userEvent.clear(resendAttempts);
    await userEvent.click(form.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save' }));
    await expect(resendAttempts).toHaveAccessibleDescription('Max Resend Attempts cannot be empty');
    await userEvent.type(resendAttempts, '5');
    const validity = form.getByRole('spinbutton', { name: 'Verification link validity' });
    await userEvent.clear(validity);
    await userEvent.click(form.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save' }));
    await expect(form.getByRole('alert')).toHaveTextContent('Verification Link Validity cannot be empty');
    await expect(validity).toHaveAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
    await expect(validity).toHaveAccessibleDescription('Day(s) Verification Link Validity cannot be empty');
    await expect(form.getByRole('alert').parentElement).toContainElement(validity);
    await userEvent.type(validity, '10');
    let emailTemplateGeometry: string[] = [];
    for (const [link, title, sample] of [
      ['Verification Link Email', 'Edit Email Content', 'Email template body'],
      ['Verification Page', 'Edit Verification Page', 'Verification page body'],
    ]) {
      const settings = within(await body.findByRole('dialog'));
      const trigger = settings.getByRole('button', { name: link });
      await expect(trigger).toHaveClass('record-auth-form__template-input');
      await expect(trigger).not.toHaveClass('button-btn');

import { useState } from 'react';
import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react-vite';
import { expect, userEvent, within } from 'storybook/test';
import { Button } from '../components/Button/Button';
import { Icon } from '../components/Icon/Icon';
import { NextGenTopBand } from '../components/NextGenTopBand/NextGenTopBand';
import { Tabs } from '../components/Tabs/Tabs';
import { Tooltip } from '../components/Tooltip/Tooltip';
import { VerticalTabs } from '../components/VerticalTabs/VerticalTabs';
import {
  CANVAS_HEIGHT, CANVAS_WIDTH, NODE_HEIGHT, NODE_WIDTH,
  SANDBOX_CONNECTIONS, SANDBOX_NODES, SANDBOX_TABS, SB_SETUP_ITEMS,
} from './SbConnections.data';
import type { SandboxConnection, SandboxNode } from './SbConnections.data';
import './SbConnections.css';

const ENVIRONMENT = 'Pre production';

function nodeLabel(node: SandboxNode) {
  return node.type ? `${node.name} (${node.type})` : node.name;
}

function ConnectionLegend() {
  return (
    <ul className="sb-connections__legend" aria-label="Legend">
      <li><span className="sb-connections__legend-dot" data-kind="inbound" aria-hidden="true" />Inbound</li>
      <li><span className="sb-connections__legend-dot" data-kind="outbound" aria-hidden="true" />Outbound</li>
      <li><span className="sb-connections__badge sb-connections__badge--static" aria-hidden="true">##</span>Waiting for deployment</li>
    </ul>
  );
}

const CORNER_RADIUS = 10;

/** Polyline path with each bend replaced by a smooth curve. */
function roundedPath(points: SandboxConnection['points']) {
  const [first, ...others] = points;
  let d = `M${first[0]} ${first[1]}`;
  for (let i = 1; i < points.length - 1; i++) {
    const [px, py] = points[i - 1];
    const [cx, cy] = points[i];
    const [nx, ny] = points[i + 1];
    const inLen = Math.hypot(cx - px, cy - py);
    const outLen = Math.hypot(nx - cx, ny - cy);
    const r = Math.min(CORNER_RADIUS, inLen / 2, outLen / 2);
    const ax = cx - ((cx - px) / inLen) * r;
    const ay = cy - ((cy - py) / inLen) * r;
    const bx = cx + ((nx - cx) / outLen) * r;
    const by = cy + ((ny - cy) / outLen) * r;
    d += ` L${ax} ${ay} Q${cx} ${cy} ${bx} ${by}`;
  }
  const last = others[others.length - 1];
  return `${d} L${last[0]} ${last[1]}`;
}

function ConnectionLine({ connection }: { connection: SandboxConnection }) {
  const [start, ...rest] = connection.points;
  const tip = rest[rest.length - 1];
  const before = connection.points[connection.points.length - 2];
  const angle = Math.atan2(tip[1] - before[1], tip[0] - before[0]) * 180 / Math.PI;
  return (
    <g className="sb-connections__line" data-kind={connection.kind}>
      <path d={roundedPath(connection.points)} fill="none" />
      {/* 9px circle + 1px outline = 10px end-dot. */}
      <circle cx={start[0]} cy={start[1]} r={4.5} />
      {/* Figma arrowhead: 12.5px wide, 7.7px deep, tip on the line end. */}
      <path d="M0 0 -7.7 -6.25 -7.7 6.25Z" transform={`translate(${tip[0]} ${tip[1]}) rotate(${angle})`} />
    </g>
  );
}

export function SbConnectionsDiagram({ nodes = SANDBOX_NODES, connections = SANDBOX_CONNECTIONS }: {
  nodes?: SandboxNode[]; connections?: SandboxConnection[];
}) {
  const byId = new Map(nodes.map(node => [node.id, node]));
  return (
    <figure className="sb-connections__diagram" aria-labelledby="sb-connections-diagram-caption">
      <figcaption id="sb-connections-diagram-caption" className="sb-connections__sr-only">Sandbox connection map</figcaption>
      <div className="sb-connections__canvas" style={{ width: CANVAS_WIDTH, height: CANVAS_HEIGHT }}>
        <ul className="sb-connections__nodes" aria-label="Environments">
          {nodes.map(node => (
            <li key={node.id} className="sb-connections__node" data-highlighted={node.highlighted || undefined}
              style={{ left: node.x, top: node.y, width: NODE_WIDTH, height: NODE_HEIGHT }}>
              <span className="sb-connections__node-name">{node.icon && <Icon name={node.icon} size={16} className="sb-connections__node-icon" />}{node.name}</span>
              {node.type && <span className="sb-connections__node-type">{node.type}</span>}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
        {/* Drawn above the cards so the connector end-circles stay fully visible. */}
        <svg className="sb-connections__lines" width={CANVAS_WIDTH} height={CANVAS_HEIGHT}
          viewBox={`0 0 ${CANVAS_WIDTH} ${CANVAS_HEIGHT}`} aria-hidden="true">
          {connections.map(connection => <ConnectionLine key={connection.id} connection={connection} />)}
        </svg>
        {connections.filter(connection => connection.count > 0).map(connection => (
          <Tooltip key={connection.id} content={`${connection.count} changes waiting for deployment`}
            variant="black" placement="bottom" wrapperClassName="sb-connections__badge-anchor"
            wrapperStyle={{ left: connection.badge[0], top: connection.badge[1] }}>
            <span className="sb-connections__badge" aria-hidden="true">{connection.count}</span>
          </Tooltip>
        ))}
      </div>
      <ul className="sb-connections__sr-only" aria-label="Connections">
        {connections.map(connection => {
          const from = byId.get(connection.from);
          const to = byId.get(connection.to);
          if (!from || !to) return null;
          return <li key={connection.id}>
            {`${nodeLabel(from)} to ${nodeLabel(to)}, ${connection.kind}, ${connection.count} changes waiting for deployment`}
          </li>;
        })}
      </ul>
    </figure>
  );
}

function SbConnectionsPage({ initialTab = 'connections' }: { initialTab?: string }) {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState(initialTab);
  const [sidebarId, setSidebarId] = useState('sandbox');
  const tabLabel = SANDBOX_TABS.find(tab => tab.id === activeTab)?.label ?? '';
  return (
    <div className="sb-connections">
      <header><NextGenTopBand moduleLabel={null} showTerritory={false} /></header>
      <aside className="sb-connections__sidebar" aria-label="Setup navigation">
        <VerticalTabs variant="setup" searchable width="100%" items={SB_SETUP_ITEMS}
          activeId={sidebarId} onSelect={setSidebarId} />
      </aside>
      <main className="sb-connections__workspace" aria-label="Sandbox">
        <Tabs tabs={SANDBOX_TABS} activeTab={activeTab} onChange={setActiveTab} />
        <section className="sb-connections__content" role="tabpanel" aria-label={tabLabel}>
          {activeTab === 'connections' ? <>
            <div className="sb-connections__intro">
              <div>
                <h1>Connections</h1>
                <p>Connections to receive or export the changes with respect to the {ENVIRONMENT} sandbox are listed below</p>
              </div>
              <Button variant="primary">Manage Connections</Button>
            </div>
            <ConnectionLegend />
            <div className="sb-connections__panel">
              <SbConnectionsDiagram />
            </div>
          </> : <p className="sb-connections__note">{tabLabel} is outside the scope of this pattern.</p>}
        </section>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

      <figcaption id="sb-connections-diagram-caption" className="sb-connections__sr-only">Sandbox connection map</figcaption>

              <span className="sb-connections__node-name">{node.icon && <Icon name={node.icon} size={16} className="sb-connections__node-icon" />}{node.name}</span>

  if (frequency === "monthly") {

    if (monthlyMode === "days_of_month") {
      const dayList = selectedMonthDays.length > 0 ? selectedMonthDays.slice().sort((a, b) => a - b).join(", ") : "no days selected";

    const wd = monthlyWeekDay.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + monthlyWeekDay.slice(1);
    return `Email will be sent every ${everyN} ${unit} on the ${pos} ${wd} from ${dateStr}, at ${timeStr} IST${tail}`;
  }
  if (frequency === "quarterly") {
    const unit = everyN === 1 ? "quarter" : "quarters";
    const mp = quarterMonthPos.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + quarterMonthPos.slice(1);
    const qd = quarterDay === "15th" ? "15th" : quarterDay.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + quarterDay.slice(1);
    return `Email will be sent every ${everyN} ${unit}, in the ${mp} month on the ${qd} day, from ${dateStr}, at ${timeStr} IST${tail}`;
  }
  if (frequency === "yearly") {
    const unit = everyN === 1 ? "year" : "years";
    const months = yearlyMonths.length > 0 ? yearlyMonths.join(", ") : "no months selected";
    const on = yearlyOn === "15th" ? "15th" : yearlyOn.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + yearlyOn.slice(1);
    return `Email will be sent every ${everyN} ${unit} in ${months}, on the ${on} day, from ${dateStr}, at ${timeStr} IST${tail}`;

const SendDashboardScheduler = () => {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

  const [frequency, setFrequency] = useState("once");
  const [date, setDate] = useState(todayDDMMYYYY);
  const [time, setTime] = useState("12:20 PM");
  const [skipNoData, setSkipNoData] = useState(true);
  const [workingOnly, setWorkingOnly] = useState(false);
  const [startOnError, setStartOnError] = useState(false);
  const [everyN, setEveryN] = useState(2);
  const [ends, setEnds] = useState("never");
  const [endsAfterN, setEndsAfterN] = useState(1);
  const [endsOnDate, setEndsOnDate] = useState("");
  const [tzOpen, setTzOpen] = useState(false);
  const [timezone, setTimezone] = useState("(GMT 5:30) India Standard Time (Asia/Kolkata)");
  const [tzDraft, setTzDraft] = useState(timezone);
  const [selectedDays, setSelectedDays] = useState([]);
  const [monthlyMode, setMonthlyMode] = useState("days_of_month");
  const [selectedMonthDays, setSelectedMonthDays] = useState([]);
  const [monthlyPos, setMonthlyPos] = useState("first");
  const [monthlyWeekDay, setMonthlyWeekDay] = useState("monday");
  const [quarterMonthPos, setQuarterMonthPos] = useState("first");
  const [quarterDay, setQuarterDay] = useState("first");
  const [yearlyMonths, setYearlyMonths] = useState(["January"]);
  const [yearlyOn, setYearlyOn] = useState("first");
  const showSchedule = sendOption === "send_later";
  const summary = showSchedule ? formatScheduleSummary(
    date,
    time,
    frequency,
    everyN,
    ends,
    endsAfterN,
    endsOnDate,
    selectedDays,
    monthlyMode,
    selectedMonthDays,
    monthlyPos,
    monthlyWeekDay,
    quarterMonthPos,
    quarterDay,
    yearlyMonths,
    yearlyOn
  ) : "";
  const handleSave = () => {
    if (showSchedule) {
      if (!date.trim()) {
        setStartOnError(true);
        return;
      }
      const parsed = parseDDMMYYYY(date);
      const today = new Date();
      today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
      if (isNaN(parsed.getTime()) || parsed < today) {
        setStartOnError(true);
        return;
      }
    }
    setOpen(false);
  };
  return <>
      <Button variant="primary" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
        Send Email

    options={[

    ]}
  />

        {

  }
        {showSchedule && <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: COLS, columnGap: 20, alignItems: "start", width: W }}>
            <span style={FIELD_LABEL_STYLE}>Frequency</span>
            <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 10 }}>
              <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                <Dropdown
    layout="vertical"
    width="100%"
    value={frequency}
    onChange={(val) => {
      setFrequency(val);
      setEnds("never");
    }}
    options={[
      { value: "once", label: "Once" },

      { value: "yearly", label: "Yearly" }
    ]}
  />
              </div>

                  <span style={INLINE_TEXT_STYLE}>{FREQ_UNIT[frequency]}</span>

        {showSchedule && <DateTimeInput
    label="Start On"
    layout="horizontal"
    width={W}
    columns={COLS}
    dateValue={date}
    timeValue={time}
    error={startOnError}
    helperText={startOnError ? (!date.trim() ? "Please enter a start date." : "Start date cannot be in the past.") : void 0}
    onDateChange={(val) => {
      setDate(val);
      setStartOnError(false);
    }}
    onTimeChange={(val) => setTime(val)}
  />}

        {
    /* Timezone note — always below Start On */
  }
        {showSchedule && <p
    style={{
      margin: 0,
      marginTop: -15,
      paddingLeft: FIELD_OFFSET,
      fontFamily: "var(--ds-font-family-base)",
      fontSize: "var(--ds-font-size-sm)",
      color: "var(--ds-text-muted)",
      lineHeight: "var(--ds-line-height-base)"
    }}
  >
            <span style={{ color: "var(--ds-text-label)" }}>Time Zone: </span>
            {timezone}
            <button type="button" className="input-link-btn" style={{ marginLeft: 4 }} onClick={() => {
    setTzDraft(timezone);
    setTzOpen(true);
  }}>
              Change
            </button>
          </p>}

        {
    /* Ends — shown for all repeating frequencies */
  }
        {showSchedule && frequency !== "once" && <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: COLS, columnGap: 20, alignItems: "start", width: W }}>
            <span style={FIELD_LABEL_STYLE}>Ends</span>
            <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 8 }}>
              <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                <Dropdown
    layout="vertical"
    width="100%"
    value={ends}
    onChange={(val) => setEnds(val)}
    options={[
      { value: "never", label: "Never" },
      { value: "after_n", label: "After N times", triggerLabel: "After" },
      { value: "on_date", label: "On Specific Date" }
    ]}
  />
              </div>
              {ends === "after_n" && <>
                  <Input
    layout="vertical"
    type="number"
    width={70}
    value={String(endsAfterN)}
    min={1}
    onChange={(e) => setEndsAfterN(Math.max(1, Number(e.target.value)))}
  />
                  <span style={INLINE_TEXT_STYLE}>times</span>
                </>}
              {ends === "on_date" && <DateTimeInput
    layout="vertical"
    width={160}
    dateOnly
    dateValue={endsOnDate}
    onDateChange={(val) => setEndsOnDate(val)}
  />}
            </div>
          </div>}

        {
    /* Scheduler run summary */
  }
        {showSchedule && summary && <div className="sds-summary-note" style={{ paddingLeft: FIELD_OFFSET }}>
            <style>{`.sds-summary-note .msg-info-label { display: none; }`}</style>
            <MessageInfo variant="info" message={summary} />
          </div>}

        {
    /* Delivery preferences */
  }
        <div
    style={{
      display: "flex",
      flexDirection: "column",
      gap: "15px"
    }}
  >
          <Checkbox
    id="skip-no-data"
    label="Do not send Email when there is no data in the chart."
    checked={skipNoData}
    onChange={(e) => setSkipNoData(e.target.checked)}
  />

          <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 10 }}>
            <Checkbox

    checked={workingOnly}
