import { useId, useState } from 'react';
import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react-vite';
import { expect, userEvent, within } from 'storybook/test';
import { NextGenTopBand } from '../components/NextGenTopBand/NextGenTopBand';
import { NextGenLeftMenu } from '../components/NextGenLeftMenu/NextGenLeftMenu';
import { WMSBar } from '../components/WMSBar/WMSBar';
import { Button } from '../components/Button/Button';
import { Checkbox } from '../components/Checkbox/Checkbox';
import { Dropdown } from '../components/Dropdown/Dropdown';
import { FormSection } from '../components/FormSection/FormSection';
import { MessageInfo } from '../components/MessageInfo/MessageInfo';
import { ProgressBar } from '../components/ProgressBar/ProgressBar';
import { SetupTable } from '../components/Table/Table';
import './CrmHomepage.css';

const meta = {
  title: 'Design System/Patterns/crm-homepage',
  includeStories: ['Default', 'EmptyState'],
  parameters: {
    layout: 'fullscreen',
    docs: { description: { component: 'A sales command center with CRM navigation, KPIs, performance breakdown, actionable insights, deals, daily tasks, meetings, and recent conversations. Composed from existing components; all data and interactions are local examples.' } },
  },
} satisfies Meta;
export default meta;
type Story = StoryObj<typeof meta>;
import { CHATS, DEALS, INITIAL_TASKS, PERFORMANCE, PERIODS } from './CrmHomepage.data';
import type { Period } from './CrmHomepage.data';
const DEAL_COLUMNS = [
  { key: 'name', label: 'Account', width: 190 },
  { key: 'stage', label: 'Stage', width: 130 },
  { key: 'amount', label: 'Amount', width: 100 },
  { key: 'close', label: 'Close date', width: 90 },
  { key: 'attention', label: 'Next step', width: 140 },
];
const PIPELINE = [
  { label: 'Qualification', amount: '$18,000', count: 1, share: 16 },
  { label: 'Proposal', amount: '$24,500', count: 1, share: 21 },
  { label: 'Negotiation', amount: '$73,000', count: 2, share: 63 },
];
const MEETINGS = [
  { id: 'discovery', time: '10:30', title: 'Discovery call', account: 'Atlas Logistics · Daniel Kim', duration: 'AM · 30 min' },
  { id: 'review', time: '14:00', title: 'Proposal review', account: 'Meridian Health · Sofia Martinez', duration: '45 min' },
];

// Story-local composition, not a new design-system component.
export function CrmHomepage({ empty = false, children, showTerritory = true, workspaceName = 'Sales workspace' }: { empty?: boolean; children?: ReactNode; showTerritory?: boolean; workspaceName?: string }) {
  const headingId = useId();
  const [period, setPeriod] = useState<Period>('month');
  const [tasks, setTasks] = useState(empty ? [] : INITIAL_TASKS);
  const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [showCompleted, setShowCompleted] = useState(false);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState('');
  const [activeChat, setActiveChat] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [readChats, setReadChats] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [attentionOnly, setAttentionOnly] = useState(false);
  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const performance = PERFORMANCE[period];
  const pendingTasks = tasks.filter(task => !task.completed);
  const visibleTasks = showCompleted ? tasks : pendingTasks;
  const visibleDeals = empty ? [] : attentionOnly ? DEALS.filter(deal => deal.id === 'northstar') : DEALS;
  const selectedChat = CHATS.find(chat => chat.id === activeChat);
  const unreadCount = empty ? 0 : CHATS.filter(chat => chat.unread && !readChats.includes(chat.id)).length;
  const metrics = [
    { label: 'Closed revenue', value: empty ? '$0' : performance.revenue, detail: 'Revenue booked', change: performance.changes[0] },
    { label: 'Deals won', value: empty ? '0' : performance.deals, detail: 'Closed opportunities', change: performance.changes[1] },
    { label: 'New leads', value: empty ? '0' : performance.leads, detail: 'Added to your pipeline', change: performance.changes[2] },
    { label: 'Lead conversion', value: empty ? '0%' : performance.conversion, detail: 'Leads converted to deals', change: performance.changes[3] },
  ];
  const openChat = (id: string) => {
    setActiveChat(id);
    setReadChats(current => current.includes(id) ? current : [...current, id]);
  };

  return (
    <div className="crm-homepage">
      <div className="crm-homepage__shell">
        <aside className="crm-homepage__sidebar" data-open={menuOpen || undefined} aria-label="CRM navigation">
          <NextGenLeftMenu activeId="home" teamspaceName={workspaceName} onItemClick={(id: string) => {
            setMenuOpen(false);
            if (id !== 'home') setNotice(`${id.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + id.slice(1)} selected. Navigation is a local preview; no CRM records are changed.`);
          }} />
        </aside>
        <div className="crm-homepage__workspace">
          <header>
            <NextGenTopBand moduleLabel="Home" userInitials="AS" userAvatarSrc={`${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}images/avatars/user_06.jpg`} showTerritory={showTerritory}
              onAddNew={() => setNotice('Quick create selected. In a connected CRM, this opens record creation.')}
              onCalendar={() => document.getElementById(`${headingId}-meetings`)?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' })} />
          </header>
          <main className="crm-homepage__main" aria-labelledby={children ? undefined : headingId} aria-label={children ? 'CRM homepage' : undefined}>
            <div className="crm-homepage__mobile-menu">
              <Button variant="default" aria-expanded={menuOpen} onClick={() => setMenuOpen(current => !current)}>{menuOpen ? 'Close navigation' : 'Open navigation'}</Button>
            </div>
            {children && notice && <div role="status"><MessageInfo variant="info" message={notice} /></div>}
            {children ?? <>
            <div className="crm-homepage__heading">
              <div>
                <p className="crm-homepage__eyebrow">YOUR SALES WORKSPACE · FRIDAY, JUNE 19</p>
                <h1 id={headingId}>Welcome back, Ananya</h1>
                <p>{empty ? 'Your next chapter starts here. Build your pipeline and plan your day.' : 'A strong month so far. Let’s keep your next opportunities moving.'}</p>
              </div>
              <Dropdown label="Reporting period" layout="vertical" width="fit-content" options={PERIODS} value={period} onChange={(value: string) => setPeriod(value as Period)} />
            </div>
            {notice && <div role="status"><MessageInfo variant="info" message={notice} /></div>}
            <section aria-label="Sales overview">
              <dl className="crm-homepage__metrics">
                {metrics.map((metric, index) => (
                  <div key={metric.label} className="crm-homepage__metric" data-tone={index}>
                    <dt>{metric.label}</dt><dd>{metric.value}</dd>
                    <div className="crm-homepage__metric-change"><span>{empty ? '—' : metric.change}</span> <span>vs. previous {period}</span></div>
                    <p>{metric.detail}</p>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </dl>
            </section>
            <div className="crm-homepage__dashboard">
              <div className="crm-homepage__primary">
                <section className="crm-homepage__panel" aria-label="Sales performance">
                  <FormSection title="Sales performance">
                    <div className="crm-homepage__section-heading"><p>Progress toward your {period === 'month' ? 'monthly' : 'quarterly'} revenue goal</p><span className="crm-homepage__badge">{period === 'month' ? 'June 2026' : 'Q2 2026'}</span></div>
                    <div className="crm-homepage__performance">
                      <section className="crm-homepage__target" aria-label="Revenue target">
                        <p>Revenue target</p>
                        <div className="crm-homepage__target-value">{empty ? '0' : performance.progress}<span>%</span></div>
                        <p>{empty ? 'Start closing deals to build momentum.' : `${performance.remaining} to reach your goal`}</p>
                        <div role="progressbar" aria-label="Revenue target progress" aria-valuemin={0} aria-valuemax={100} aria-valuenow={empty ? 0 : performance.progress} aria-valuetext={`${empty ? '$0' : performance.revenue} of ${performance.target}`}>
                          <ProgressBar value={empty ? 0 : performance.progress} leftLabel={empty ? '$0' : performance.revenue} rightLabel={performance.target} />
                        </div>
                      </section>
                      <section className="crm-homepage__pipeline" aria-label="Pipeline by stage">
                        <div className="crm-homepage__section-heading"><h2>Pipeline by stage</h2><strong>{empty ? '$0' : performance.pipeline}</strong></div>
                        {PIPELINE.map(stage => <div key={stage.label} className="crm-homepage__stage">
                          <div className="crm-homepage__section-heading"><p>{stage.label} <span>· {empty ? 0 : stage.count} {stage.count === 1 ? 'deal' : 'deals'}</span></p><strong>{empty ? '$0' : stage.amount}</strong></div>
                          <div role="meter" aria-label={`${stage.label} share of pipeline`} aria-valuemin={0} aria-valuemax={100} aria-valuenow={empty ? 0 : stage.share}>
                            <ProgressBar value={empty ? 0 : stage.share} />
                          </div>
                        </div>)}
                        <p className="crm-homepage__caption">Share of open pipeline value · all closing dates</p>
                      </section>
                    </div>
                  </FormSection>
                </section>
                <section className="crm-homepage__panel" aria-label="Open deals">
                  <FormSection title="Open deals">
                    <div className="crm-homepage__section-heading"><p>{attentionOnly ? 'Opportunities with a follow-up due.' : 'Your next opportunities, ordered by closing date.'}</p><span role="status">{selectedIds.length} selected</span></div>
                    {attentionOnly && <Button variant="link-primary" onClick={() => { setAttentionOnly(false); setSelectedIds([]); }}>Show all deals</Button>}
                    <SetupTable columns={DEAL_COLUMNS} rows={visibleDeals} selectable selectedIds={selectedIds} onSelectionChange={setSelectedIds} width="100%" emptyMessage="No open deals yet. New opportunities will appear here." />
                  </FormSection>
                </section>
                <div className="crm-homepage__columns">
                  <section className="crm-homepage__panel" aria-label="Today's tasks">
                    <FormSection title="Today's tasks">
                      <div className="crm-homepage__section-heading"><span role="status">{pendingTasks.length} tasks remaining</span><Button variant="link-primary" onClick={() => setShowCompleted(current => !current)} aria-pressed={showCompleted}>{showCompleted ? 'Hide completed' : 'Show completed'}</Button></div>
                      {visibleTasks.length ? <ul className="crm-homepage__list">{visibleTasks.map(task => <li key={task.id} className="crm-homepage__task" data-completed={task.completed || undefined}>
                        <Checkbox label={task.title} checked={task.completed} onChange={() => setTasks(current => current.map(item => item.id === task.id ? { ...item, completed: !item.completed } : item))} /><p>{task.detail}</p>
                      </li>)}</ul> : <p className="crm-homepage__empty">{tasks.length ? 'All caught up! No pending tasks.' : 'No tasks scheduled for today.'}</p>}
                    </FormSection>
                  </section>
                  <section id={`${headingId}-meetings`} className="crm-homepage__panel" aria-label="Upcoming meetings">
                    <FormSection title="Upcoming meetings">
                      <p>Today · Friday, June 19, 2026</p>
                      {empty ? <p className="crm-homepage__empty">No meetings scheduled for today.</p> : <ul className="crm-homepage__list">{MEETINGS.map(meeting => <li key={meeting.id} className="crm-homepage__meeting">
                        <div className="crm-homepage__time"><strong>{meeting.time}</strong><span>{meeting.duration}</span></div><div><h2>{meeting.title}</h2><p>{meeting.account}</p></div>
                      </li>)}</ul>}
                    </FormSection>
                  </section>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="crm-homepage__context">
                <section className="crm-homepage__panel crm-homepage__insights" aria-label="Sales insights">
                  <FormSection title="Insights for you">
                    <p>Small actions. Meaningful momentum.</p>
                    {empty ? <p className="crm-homepage__empty">Insights will appear as your pipeline grows.</p> : <ul className="crm-homepage__list">
                      <li><span className="crm-homepage__badge crm-homepage__badge--warning">FOLLOW-UP DUE</span><h2>Keep Northstar moving</h2><p>Your $32,000 opportunity is closing in 7 days. Check in with Priya before the weekend.</p><Button variant="link-primary" onClick={() => { setAttentionOnly(true); setSelectedIds([]); }}>Review follow-up</Button></li>
                      <li><span className="crm-homepage__badge">CLOSING SOON</span><h2>Two deals, $56,500 in play</h2><p>Northstar and Meridian are due to close this month. Prioritize their next steps.</p><Button variant="link-primary" onClick={() => { setAttentionOnly(false); setSelectedIds(['northstar', 'meridian']); }}>Select closing deals</Button></li>
                    </ul>}
                  </FormSection>
                </section>
                <section className="crm-homepage__panel" aria-label="Recent chats">
                  <FormSection title="Recent chats">
                    <div className="crm-homepage__section-heading"><p>Stay close to your customers</p><span className="crm-homepage__badge" role="status">{unreadCount} unread</span></div>
                    {empty ? <p className="crm-homepage__empty">No recent conversations. Your chats will appear here.</p> : <ul className="crm-homepage__list">{CHATS.map(chat => <li key={chat.id} className="crm-homepage__chat" data-active={activeChat === chat.id || undefined}>
                      <span className="crm-homepage__initials" aria-hidden="true">{chat.initials}</span>
                      <div className="crm-homepage__chat-content"><div className="crm-homepage__section-heading"><Button variant="link-default" aria-pressed={activeChat === chat.id} onClick={() => openChat(chat.id)}>{chat.name}</Button><span className="crm-homepage__caption">{chat.time}</span></div><p>{chat.preview}</p>{chat.unread && !readChats.includes(chat.id) && <span className="crm-homepage__chat-unread">Unread</span>}</div>
                    </li>)}</ul>}
                    {selectedChat && <div className="crm-homepage__conversation" role="status"><h2>Conversation with {selectedChat.name}</h2><p>{selectedChat.preview}</p><p className="crm-homepage__caption">Local preview · replying requires a connected CRM.</p><Button variant="link-primary" onClick={() => setActiveChat(null)}>Close conversation</Button></div>}
                  </FormSection>
                </section>
              </div>
            </div>
            </>}
          </main>
        </div>
      </div>
      <WMSBar onChatClick={() => { if (!empty) openChat('priya'); document.querySelector('.crm-homepage__chat')?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' }); }} onTabChange={(tab: string) => setNotice(`${tab.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + tab.slice(1)} selected in the communication bar. This is a local preview.`)} />
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import type { ChangeEvent, FormEvent } from 'react';
import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react-vite';
import { expect, userEvent, waitFor, within } from 'storybook/test';
import { Modal } from '../components/Modal/Modal';
import { Input } from '../components/Input/Input';
import { Dropdown } from '../components/Dropdown/Dropdown';
import { Radio } from '../components/Radio/Radio';
import { Checkbox } from '../components/Checkbox/Checkbox';
import { Switch } from '../components/Switch/Switch';
import { Button } from '../components/Button/Button';
import './DashboardExport.css';

type FileFormat = 'pdf' | 'html' | 'image';
type PatternArgs = { initialFormat: FileFormat; initiallyOpen: boolean; phase1: boolean };

const formats = [
  { value: 'pdf', label: 'PDF' },
  { value: 'html', label: 'HTML' },
  { value: 'image', label: 'Image' },
];
const paperSizes = ['Letter', 'Legal', 'Tabloid', 'A3', 'A4'].map(value => ({ value, label: value }));

const meta = {
  title: 'Design System/Patterns/Dashboard Export',
  parameters: {
    layout: 'centered',
    docs: {
      description: {
        component: 'Dashboard export settings modal based on the PM wireframe. Choose a file name and format, then configure PDF layout, included content, orientation, paper size, and optional password protection. Export validates the settings and closes without an acknowledgement message; generating files and encrypting PDFs require a host application export service.',
      },
    },
  },
  args: { initialFormat: 'pdf', initiallyOpen: true, phase1: false },
  argTypes: {
    initialFormat: { control: 'select', options: formats.map(format => format.value) },
    initiallyOpen: { control: 'boolean' },
    phase1: { control: 'boolean', description: 'Hide orientation, paper settings, and password protection.' },
  },
} satisfies Meta<PatternArgs>;
export default meta;
type Story = StoryObj<typeof meta>;

export const DashboardExport: Story = {
  args: {},

  render: function DashboardExportPattern({ initialFormat, initiallyOpen, phase1 }) {
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(initiallyOpen);
    const [fileName, setFileName] = useState('org_overview');
    const [format, setFormat] = useState<FileFormat>(initialFormat);
    const [eachComponentPerPage, setEachComponentPerPage] = useState(false);
    const [includeTitle, setIncludeTitle] = useState(true);
    const [includeDescription, setIncludeDescription] = useState(true);
    const [orientation, setOrientation] = useState('portrait');
    const [paperSize, setPaperSize] = useState('Letter');
    const [passwordEnabled, setPasswordEnabled] = useState(false);
    const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
    const [passwordSubmitted, setPasswordSubmitted] = useState(false);
    const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState(false);
    const formRef = useRef<HTMLFormElement>(null);
    const triggerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    const id = useId();
    const isPdf = format === 'pdf';
    const nameError = submitted && !fileName.trim();
    const passwordError = passwordSubmitted && !phase1 && isPdf && passwordEnabled && !password.trim();

    // Keep keyboard navigation inside this modal without changing the shared Modal.
    useEffect(() => {
      if (!open) return;
      const launchButton = triggerRef.current?.querySelector('button');
      const trapFocus = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
        if (event.key !== 'Tab') return;
        const dialog = formRef.current?.closest('[role="dialog"]');
        const elements = Array.from(dialog?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(
          'button:not([disabled]), input:not([disabled]), [tabindex="0"]',
        ) ?? []).filter(element => element.getClientRects().length > 0);
        const first = elements[0];
        const last = elements[elements.length - 1];
        if (!first || !last) return;
        if (event.shiftKey && (document.activeElement === first || !dialog?.contains(document.activeElement))) {
          event.preventDefault();
          last.focus();
        } else if (!event.shiftKey && (document.activeElement === last || !dialog?.contains(document.activeElement))) {
          event.preventDefault();
          first.focus();
        }
      };
      document.addEventListener('keydown', trapFocus);
      return () => {
        document.removeEventListener('keydown', trapFocus);
        launchButton?.focus();
      };
    }, [open]);

    const close = () => {
      setOpen(false);
      setPassword('');
      setPasswordEnabled(false);
      setSubmitted(false);
      setPasswordSubmitted(false);
    };
    const save = () => {
      setSubmitted(true);
      setPasswordSubmitted(passwordEnabled);
      if (!fileName.trim() || (!phase1 && isPdf && passwordEnabled && !password.trim())) {
        const fieldId = !fileName.trim() ? `${id}-name` : `${id}-password`;
        document.getElementById(fieldId)?.focus();
        return;
      }
      close();
    };

    return (
      <div className="dashboard-export-launcher">
        <div ref={triggerRef}>
          <Button variant="primary" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>Export dashboard</Button>
        </div>
        <Modal
          isOpen={open}
          title={'Export Dashboard - "Org Overview"'}
          onClose={close}
          onSave={save}
          cancelLabel="Cancel"
          saveLabel="Export"
          width={phase1 ? 'min(575px, 100vw)' : 'min(760px, 100vw)'}
          className={`dashboard-export-modal${phase1 ? ' dashboard-export-modal--phase1' : ''}`}
        >
          <form ref={formRef} className="dashboard-export-form" noValidate onSubmit={(event: FormEvent) => {
            event.preventDefault();
            save();
          }}>
            <Input
              id={`${id}-name`}
              label="File name"
              width="100%"
              columns="var(--dashboard-export-columns)"
              value={fileName}
              onChange={(event: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => setFileName(event.target.value.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '_'))}
              required
              error={nameError}
              aria-invalid={nameError || undefined}
              helperText={nameError ? 'Enter a file name.' : undefined}
            />
            <div className="dashboard-export-row">
              <span id={`${id}-include`} className="dashboard-export-label">Include</span>
              <fieldset className="dashboard-export-options dashboard-export-includes" aria-labelledby={`${id}-include`}>
                <Checkbox label="Title" checked={includeTitle} onChange={(event: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => setIncludeTitle(event.target.checked)} />
                <Checkbox label="Description" checked={includeDescription} onChange={(event: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => setIncludeDescription(event.target.checked)} />
              </fieldset>
            </div>
            <Dropdown
              label="File format"
              triggerAriaLabel="File format"
              width="100%"
              columns="var(--dashboard-export-columns)"
              value={format}
              options={formats}
              onChange={(value: FileFormat) => {
                setFormat(value);
                setPassword('');
                setPasswordEnabled(false);
                setPasswordSubmitted(false);
              }}
            />
            {isPdf && <>
              <div className="dashboard-export-row">
                <fieldset className="dashboard-export-options dashboard-export-field" aria-label="PDF layout">
                  <Checkbox label="One component per page" checked={eachComponentPerPage} onChange={(event: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => setEachComponentPerPage(event.target.checked)} />
                </fieldset>
              </div>
              {!phase1 && <>
              <div className="dashboard-export-row">
                <span id={`${id}-orientation`} className="dashboard-export-label">Orientation</span>
                <fieldset className="dashboard-export-options" aria-labelledby={`${id}-orientation`}>
                  <Radio name={`${id}-orientation`} label="Portrait" value="portrait" checked={orientation === 'portrait'} onChange={() => setOrientation('portrait')} />
                  <Radio name={`${id}-orientation`} label="Landscape" value="landscape" checked={orientation === 'landscape'} onChange={() => setOrientation('landscape')} />
                </fieldset>
              </div>
              <Dropdown label="PDF paper settings" triggerAriaLabel="PDF paper settings" width="100%" columns="var(--dashboard-export-columns)" value={paperSize} options={paperSizes} onChange={(value: string) => setPaperSize(value)} />
              <div className="dashboard-export-row">
                <label htmlFor={`${id}-protect`} className="dashboard-export-label">Set password</label>
                <Switch id={`${id}-protect`} aria-label="Set password" checked={passwordEnabled} onChange={(event: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
                  setPasswordEnabled(event.target.checked);
                  setPassword('');
                  setPasswordSubmitted(false);
                }} />
              </div>
              {passwordEnabled && <Input
                id={`${id}-password`}
                label="Enter password"
                type="password"
                width="100%"
                columns="var(--dashboard-export-columns)"
                autoComplete="new-password"
                value={password}
                onChange={(event: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => setPassword(event.target.value)}
                aria-required="true"
                error={passwordError}
                aria-invalid={passwordError || undefined}
                helperText={passwordError ? 'Enter a password or turn off password protection.' : undefined}
              />}
              </>}
            </>}
          </form>
        </Modal>
      </div>
    );
  },

  play: async ({ canvasElement }) => {
    const page = within(canvasElement.ownerDocument.body);
    const dialog = within(await page.findByRole('dialog', { name: 'Export Dashboard - "Org Overview"' }));
    await expect(dialog.getByLabelText('File name')).toHaveValue('org_overview');
    const layoutCheckbox = dialog.getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'One component per page' });
    await expect(layoutCheckbox).not.toBeChecked();
    await userEvent.click(layoutCheckbox);
    await expect(layoutCheckbox).toBeChecked();
    await userEvent.click(layoutCheckbox);
    await expect(layoutCheckbox).not.toBeChecked();
    const includes = within(dialog.getByRole('group', { name: 'Include' }));
    await expect(includes.getByLabelText('Title')).toBeChecked();
    await expect(includes.getByLabelText('Description')).toBeChecked();
    await userEvent.click(dialog.getByRole('switch', { name: 'Set password' }));
    await expect(dialog.getByLabelText('Enter password')).not.toHaveAttribute('aria-invalid');
    await expect(dialog.getByLabelText('Enter password').closest('.input-root')).not.toHaveAttribute('data-variant', 'error');
    await userEvent.click(dialog.getByRole('button', { name: 'Export', exact: true }));
    await expect(dialog.getByLabelText('Enter password')).toHaveAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
    await userEvent.type(dialog.getByLabelText('Enter password'), 'Demo-passphrase');
    await userEvent.clear(dialog.getByLabelText('File name'));
    await userEvent.click(dialog.getByRole('button', { name: 'Export', exact: true }));
    await expect(dialog.getByLabelText('File name')).toHaveAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
    await userEvent.type(dialog.getByLabelText('File name'), 'Org Overview');
    await expect(dialog.getByLabelText('File name')).toHaveValue('org_overview');
    await userEvent.click(dialog.getByRole('button', { name: 'Export', exact: true }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(page.queryByRole('dialog')).not.toBeInTheDocument());
    await expect(page.queryByRole('status')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    // Leave the modal open for visual review after exercising the save flow.
    await userEvent.click(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Export dashboard' }));
    await expect(dialog.getByRole('switch', { name: 'Set password' })).not.toBeChecked();
  }
};

export const OtherFormats: Story = {
  ...DashboardExport,
  name: 'Other formats',
  args: { initialFormat: 'html' },
  play: async ({ canvasElement }) => {
    const page = within(canvasElement.ownerDocument.body);
    const dialog = within(await page.findByRole('dialog'));
    await expect(dialog.queryByRole('group', { name: 'PDF layout' })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    for (const format of ['Image', 'PDF']) {
      await userEvent.click(dialog.getByRole('button', { name: 'File format' }));
      await expect(page.getAllByRole('option')).toHaveLength(3);
      await expect(page.queryByRole('option', { name: 'Excel', exact: true })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
      await expect(page.queryByRole('option', { name: 'CSV', exact: true })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
      await userEvent.click(await page.findByRole('option', { name: format, exact: true }));
    }
    await expect(dialog.getByRole('group', { name: 'PDF layout' })).toBeVisible();
    await userEvent.click(dialog.getByLabelText('Landscape'));
    await expect(dialog.getByLabelText('Landscape')).toBeChecked();
    await userEvent.click(dialog.getByRole('button', { name: 'PDF paper settings' }));
    await userEvent.click(await page.findByRole('option', { name: 'A4', exact: true }));
    await expect(dialog.getByRole('button', { name: 'PDF paper settings' })).toHaveTextContent('A4');
  },
};

import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react';

const CURRENCIES = [
  { value: 'usd', label: 'USD – US Dollar' },

type Story = StoryObj;

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Create New Employee
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export const CreateEmployee: Story = {
  name: 'Create New Employee',
  render: () => {
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const [sendWelcome, setSendWelcome] = useState(false);

    const COL = '140px 390px';
    const W   = 550;

    return (
      <>
        <Button variant="primary" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
          Create New Employee
        </Button>
        <Modal
          isOpen={open}
          title="Create New Employee"
          onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
          onCancel={() => setOpen(false)}
          onSave={() => setOpen(false)}
          cancelLabel="Cancel"
          saveLabel="Save"
          width={610}
          footerNote={
            <>
              <Checkbox
                id="send-welcome"
                checked={sendWelcome}
                onChange={(e) => setSendWelcome(e.target.checked)}
              />
              <label
                htmlFor="send-welcome"
                style={{
                  fontFamily: 'var(--ds-font-family-base)',
                  fontSize: 'var(--ds-font-size-base)',
                  fontWeight: 'var(--ds-font-weight-regular)',
                  color: 'var(--ds-text-base)',
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                }}
              >
                Send welcome email to new employee
              </label>
              <Tooltip
                content="Employee will receive login credentials and onboarding instructions via email."
                variant="black"
                placement="top"
              >
                <span
                  style={{
                    display: 'inline-flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    color: 'var(--ds-text-muted, #8A94A6)',
                    cursor: 'default',
                    lineHeight: 0,
                  }}
                >
                  <Info />
                </span>
              </Tooltip>
            </>
          }
        >
          <FormSection title="Personal Information" />
          <Input label="First Name"           layout="horizontal" width={W} columns={COL} required />
          <Input label="Last Name"            layout="horizontal" width={W} columns={COL} required />
          <Input label="Employee ID"          layout="horizontal" width={W} columns={COL} />
          <Input label="Email"                layout="horizontal" width={W} columns={COL} type="email" required />
          <Input label="Phone"                layout="horizontal" width={W} columns={COL} type="tel" />

          <FormSection title="Employment Details" />
          <Dropdown label="Department"        layout="horizontal" width={W} columns={COL} options={[
            { label: 'Engineering',         value: 'engineering' },
            { label: 'Product',             value: 'product' },
            { label: 'Design',              value: 'design' },
            { label: 'Marketing',           value: 'marketing' },
            { label: 'Human Resources',     value: 'hr' },
            { label: 'Finance',             value: 'finance' },
            { label: 'Sales',               value: 'sales' },
            { label: 'Operations',          value: 'operations' },
            { label: 'Customer Support',    value: 'support' },
            { label: 'Legal & Compliance',  value: 'legal' },
          ]} />
          <Input label="Job Title"            layout="horizontal" width={W} columns={COL} />
          <DatePicker label="Date of Joining" layout="horizontal" width={W} columns={COL} />
          <Dropdown label="Reporting Manager" layout="horizontal" width={W} columns={COL} options={[
            { label: 'Alice Johnson', value: 'alice' },
            { label: 'Bob Chen',      value: 'bob' },
            { label: 'Carol Smith',   value: 'carol' },
          ]} />
          <Dropdown label="Work Location"     layout="horizontal" width={W} columns={COL} options={[
            { label: 'Head Office',     value: 'hq' },
            { label: 'Remote',          value: 'remote' },
            { label: 'Hybrid',          value: 'hybrid' },
            { label: 'Branch – NYC',    value: 'nyc' },
            { label: 'Branch – London', value: 'london' },
          ]} />

          <FormSection title="Additional" />
          <Textarea label="Notes"             layout="horizontal" width={W} columns={COL} />
        </Modal>
      </>
    );
  },
};

export const CreateContact: Story = {
  name: 'Create Contact',
  render: () => {
    const [open, setOpen]               = useState(false);
    const [emailOptOut, setEmailOptOut] = useState(false);

    const W    = 550;
    const COLS = '140px 390px';

    return (
      <>
        <Button variant="primary" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
          Create Contact
        </Button>
        <Modal
          isOpen={open}
          title="Create Contact"
          onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
          onCancel={() => setOpen(false)}
          onSave={() => setOpen(false)}
          cancelLabel="Cancel"
          saveLabel="Save Contact"
          width={610}
        >
          <FormSection title="Contact Information">
            <Input label="First Name" required layout="horizontal" width={W} columns={COLS} />
            <Input label="Last Name"           layout="horizontal" width={W} columns={COLS} />
            <Input
              label="Account Name"
              layout="horizontal"
              width={W}
              columns={COLS}
              readOnly
              placeholder="Search account…"
              suffix={
                <Tooltip content="Link this contact to an existing account" variant="black" placement="top">
                  <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', color: 'var(--ds-text-label)', cursor: 'default', lineHeight: 0 }}>
                    <Info />
                  </span>
                </Tooltip>
              }
            />
          </FormSection>

          <FormSection title="Contact Details">
            <Input label="Email"      type="email" required layout="horizontal" width={W} columns={COLS} />
            <Input label="Phone"      type="tel"            layout="horizontal" width={W} columns={COLS} />
            <Input label="Mobile"     type="tel"            layout="horizontal" width={W} columns={COLS} />
            <Input label="Department"                       layout="horizontal" width={W} columns={COLS} />
          </FormSection>

          <FormSection title="Lead & Assignment">
            <Dropdown label="Lead Source"   placeholder="Select" layout="horizontal" width={W} columns={COLS} options={[
              { value: 'web',       label: 'Web Site' },
              { value: 'cold_call', label: 'Cold Call' },
              { value: 'referral',  label: 'Referral' },
              { value: 'email',     label: 'Email Campaign' },
              { value: 'social',    label: 'Social Media' },
              { value: 'other',     label: 'Other' },
            ]} />
            <Dropdown label="Contact Owner" placeholder="Select" layout="horizontal" width={W} columns={COLS} options={[
              { value: 'chinnaiya', label: 'Chinnaiya R' },
              { value: 'priya',     label: 'Priya S' },
              { value: 'arjun',     label: 'Arjun M' },
            ]} />
          </FormSection>

          <FormSection title="Additional Information">
            <Textarea label="Description" layout="horizontal" width={W} columns={COLS} placeholder="Add Description" minHeight={90} />
            <Checkbox
              label="Email Opt-Out"
              checked={emailOptOut}
              onChange={e => setEmailOptOut(e.target.checked)}
            />
          </FormSection>
        </Modal>
      </>
    );
  },
};

export const CreateVendor: Story = {
  name: 'Create Vendor',
  render: () => {
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

      <>
        <Button variant="primary" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>

        <Modal
          isOpen={open}
          title="Create Vendor"
          onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
          onCancel={() => setOpen(false)}
          onSave={() => setOpen(false)}
          cancelLabel="Cancel"
          saveLabel="Save"
          width={610}
        >
          <FormSection title="Basic Information">
            <Input label="Vendor Name" required layout="horizontal" width={W} columns={COLS} />
            <Dropdown
              label="Vendor Owner"
              layout="horizontal" width={W} columns={COLS}
              options={[
                { value: 'chinnaiya', label: 'Chinnaiya R' },
                { value: 'priya',     label: 'Priya S' },
                { value: 'arjun',     label: 'Arjun M' },
              ]}
            />
            <Dropdown
              label="Vendor Type"
              layout="horizontal" width={W} columns={COLS}
              options={[
                { value: 'supplier',     label: 'Supplier' },
                { value: 'manufacturer', label: 'Manufacturer' },
                { value: 'distributor',  label: 'Distributor' },
                { value: 'reseller',     label: 'Reseller' },
                { value: 'consultant',   label: 'Consultant' },
              ]}
            />
          </FormSection>

          <FormSection title="Contact Details">
            <Input label="Phone"   type="tel"   layout="horizontal" width={W} columns={COLS} />
            <Input label="Email"   type="email" layout="horizontal" width={W} columns={COLS} />
            <Input label="Website" type="url"   layout="horizontal" width={W} columns={COLS} placeholder="https://" />
          </FormSection>

          <FormSection title="Address">
            <Input label="Street"   layout="horizontal" width={W} columns={COLS} />
            <Input label="City"     layout="horizontal" width={W} columns={COLS} />
            <Input label="State"    layout="horizontal" width={W} columns={COLS} />
            <Dropdown label="Country" layout="horizontal" width={W} columns={COLS} options={COUNTRIES} />
            <Input label="Zip Code" layout="horizontal" width={W} columns={COLS} />
          </FormSection>

          <FormSection title="Financial">
            <Dropdown
              label="Payment Terms"
              layout="horizontal" width={W} columns={COLS}
              options={[
                { value: 'net15',   label: 'Net 15' },
                { value: 'net30',   label: 'Net 30' },
                { value: 'net45',   label: 'Net 45' },
                { value: 'net60',   label: 'Net 60' },
                { value: 'cod',     label: 'Cash on Delivery' },
                { value: 'prepaid', label: 'Prepaid' },
              ]}
            />
            <Dropdown label="Currency" layout="horizontal" width={W} columns={COLS} options={CURRENCIES} />
            <Input label="Tax ID / GST" layout="horizontal" width={W} columns={COLS} />
          </FormSection>

          <FormSection title="Additional">
            <Textarea label="Description" layout="horizontal" width={W} columns={COLS} placeholder="Add a description…" minHeight={90} />
          </FormSection>
        </Modal>
      </>
    );
  },
};

const CONVERSION_SNAPSHOTS = [18, 22, 19, 24, 21, 25, 23, 17, 26, 20, 24, 28, 22, 19, 25, 27, 21, 24, 18, 23, 29, 25, 22, 26, 20, 24, 27, 23, 28, 25, 21, 26, 18, 24, 29, 22, 25, 19, 27, 23, 28, 20, 26, 24, 30];

// Measure the SVG viewport so charts fill their panels without scaling text or dots.
function useChartWidth(initialWidth: number) {
  const ref = useRef<SVGSVGElement>(null);
  const [width, setWidth] = useState(initialWidth);
  const [height, setHeight] = useState(180);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!ref.current) return;
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(([entry]) => {
      if (entry.contentRect.width > 0) setWidth(entry.contentRect.width);
      if (entry.contentRect.height > 0) setHeight(entry.contentRect.height);
    });
    observer.observe(ref.current);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, []);
  return { ref, width, height };
}

// Smooth cubic segments interpolate the same coordinates used by the tooltip dots.
function curvedLine(points: { x: number; y: number }[]) {
  return points.map((point, index) => {
    if (index === 0) return `M ${point.x},${point.y}`;
    const previous = points[index - 1];
    const middleX = (previous.x + point.x) / 2;
    return `C ${middleX},${previous.y} ${middleX},${point.y} ${point.x},${point.y}`;
  }).join(' ');
}

// Catmull–Rom-style averaged tangents give the monthly joins gentler bends.
// Limit the tangents to preserve each segment's range within the chart scale.
function revenueCurve(points: { x: number; y: number }[]) {
  const slopes = points.slice(1).map((point, index) =>
    (point.y - points[index].y) / (point.x - points[index].x));
  const tangents = points.map((_, index) => {
    if (index === 0) return slopes[0];
    if (index === points.length - 1) return slopes[index - 1];
    const before = slopes[index - 1];
    const after = slopes[index];
    if (before * after <= 0) return 0;
    const average = (before + after) / 2;
    const limit = 3 * Math.min(Math.abs(before), Math.abs(after));
    return Math.sign(average) * Math.min(Math.abs(average), limit);
  });
  return points.map((point, index) => {
    if (index === 0) return `M ${point.x},${point.y}`;
    const previous = points[index - 1];
    const step = (point.x - previous.x) / 3;
    return `C ${previous.x + step},${previous.y + tangents[index - 1] * step} ${point.x - step},${point.y - tangents[index] * step} ${point.x},${point.y}`;
  }).join(' ');
}

            {empty ? <p className="crm-minimal__empty">{index === 0 ? 'Close your first deal to see revenue trends.' : 'Add opportunities to see your pipeline by stage.'}</p> : <>
              {chart.kind === 'line' ? <>
                <div className="crm-minimal__chart-summary"><strong className={`crm-minimal__trend--${direction}`}>{latest.display}</strong><p><span className={`crm-minimal__trend crm-minimal__trend--${direction}`}><span aria-hidden="true">{change >= 0 ? '↗' : '↘'}</span> {Math.abs(change / previous.value * 100).toFixed(1)}% · {Math.abs(change * 1000).toLocaleString('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD', maximumFractionDigits: 0 })}</span> vs. {previous.label}</p></div>
                <svg ref={revenueRef} className="crm-minimal__line" viewBox={`0 20 ${revenueWidth} ${Math.max(180, revenueHeight) - 20}`} preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMin meet" role="img" aria-label={`${chart.title}. ${REVENUE_LINES.filter(line => !hiddenRevenueSeries.includes(line.label)).map(line => `${line.label}: ${line.series.map(item => `${item.label}: ${item.display}`).join('; ')}`).join('. ')}`}>
                  {[0, 50, 100, 150].map(value => {
                    const y = revenueY(value);
                    return <g key={value}>
                      <line x1="52" x2={revenueWidth - 20} y1={y} y2={y} className="crm-minimal__gridline" />
                      <text className="crm-minimal__svg-label" x="44" y={y + 4} textAnchor="end">{value}k</text>
                    </g>;
                  })}
                  <line x1="52" x2="52" y1="30" y2={revenueBottom} className="crm-minimal__y-axis" />
                  {REVENUE_LINES.filter(line => !hiddenRevenueSeries.includes(line.label)).map(line => <g key={line.label} className={`crm-minimal__revenue--${line.color}`} data-revenue-series={line.label}>
                    <defs><linearGradient id={`${id}-revenue-fill-${line.color}`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0%" stopColor="currentColor" stopOpacity="0.25" /><stop offset="100%" stopColor="currentColor" stopOpacity="0.02" /></linearGradient></defs>
                    <path d={`${revenueCurve(line.series.map((item, point) => ({ x: monthX(point), y: revenueY(item.value) })))} L ${monthX(line.series.length - 1)},${revenueBottom} L ${monthX(0)},${revenueBottom} Z`} fill={`url(#${id}-revenue-fill-${line.color})`} pointerEvents="none" />
                    <path d={revenueCurve(line.series.map((item, point) => ({ x: monthX(point), y: revenueY(item.value) })))} fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinejoin="round" />
                    {line.series.map((item, point) => <Tooltip as="g" key={item.label} content={`${line.label} · ${item.label}: ${item.display}`} placement="bottom"><circle className="crm-minimal__chart-hit" {...drilldownProps({ kind: 'revenue', label: item.label, value: item.value, series: line.label })} aria-label={`${line.label} · ${item.label}: ${item.display}`} data-month={item.label} cx={monthX(point)} cy={revenueY(item.value)} r="3" fill="currentColor" stroke="transparent" strokeWidth="8" /></Tooltip>)}
                  </g>)}
                  {chart.series.map((item, point) => <text className="crm-minimal__line-month" key={item.label} x={monthX(point)} y={revenueBottom + 26} textAnchor="middle">{item.label.slice(0, 3)}</text>)}
                </svg>
                <ul className="crm-minimal__line-legend" aria-label="Revenue series">{REVENUE_LINES.map(line => <li key={line.label}><button type="button" aria-pressed={!hiddenRevenueSeries.includes(line.label)} onClick={() => setHiddenRevenueSeries(hidden => hidden.includes(line.label) ? hidden.filter(label => label !== line.label) : [...hidden, line.label])}><span className={`crm-minimal__revenue--${line.color}`} aria-hidden="true" />{line.label}</button></li>)}</ul>
              </> : <div className="crm-minimal__donut-layout">
                <svg className="crm-minimal__donut" viewBox="8 8 104 104" role="img" aria-label={`${chart.title}. ${chart.series.map(item => `${item.label}: ${item.display}`).join('; ')}`}>
                  {chart.series.map((item, segment) => {
                    const start = offset;
                    const share = item.value / total * 100;
                    offset += share;
                    return <Tooltip as="g" key={item.label} content={`${item.label}: ${item.display} (${share.toFixed(1)}%)`} placement="bottom" followCursor><circle {...drilldownProps({ kind: 'pipeline', label: item.label, value: item.value })} aria-label={`${item.label}: ${item.display}, ${share.toFixed(1)}%`} cx="60" cy="60" r="44" fill="none" pathLength="100" strokeWidth="14" strokeDasharray={`${share} ${100 - share}`} strokeDashoffset={-start} transform="rotate(-90 60 60)" className={`crm-minimal__chart-hit crm-minimal__segment--${segment}`} /></Tooltip>;
                  })}
                  {chart.series.map((item, segment) => {
                    const start = chart.series.slice(0, segment).reduce((sum, stage) => sum + stage.value, 0);
                    const angle = start / total * Math.PI * 2 - Math.PI / 2;
                    return <line key={item.label} className="crm-minimal__donut-separator" x1={60 + 37 * Math.cos(angle)} y1={60 + 37 * Math.sin(angle)} x2={60 + 51 * Math.cos(angle)} y2={60 + 51 * Math.sin(angle)} />;
                  })}
                  <text x="60" y="60" textAnchor="middle" dominantBaseline="central" className="crm-minimal__donut-total">${total.toFixed(1)}K</text>
                </svg>
                <ul className="crm-minimal__legend">{chart.series.map((item, segment) => <li key={item.label}><span className={`crm-minimal__segment--${segment}`} aria-hidden="true">●</span><div>{item.label}<strong>{item.display} <span className="crm-minimal__caption">· {(item.value / total * 100).toFixed(1)}%</span></strong></div></li>)}</ul>
              </div>}
            </>}
          </section>;
        })}
      </div>
      <div className="crm-minimal__charts crm-minimal__charts--company" style={{ order: sections.indexOf('company') + 1 }} data-dashboard-section="company">
        <section className="crm-minimal__chart crm-minimal__company-target" aria-labelledby={`${id}-company-title`}>
          <div className="crm-minimal__section-heading"><h2 id={`${id}-company-title`}>Company Target</h2></div>
          {empty ? <p className="crm-minimal__empty">Set a company target to track achievement.</p> : <>
            <div className="crm-minimal__target-summary">
              <span>Actual: <strong>{COMPANY_TARGET.achieved}</strong></span>
              <span className="crm-minimal__target-divider" aria-hidden="true">|</span>
              <span>Target: <strong>{COMPANY_TARGET.target}</strong></span>
            </div>
            <svg className="crm-minimal__target" viewBox="0 0 640 180" role="img" aria-label={`Company Target. All branches: ${COMPANY_TARGET.achieved} shipments achieved. Target: ${COMPANY_TARGET.target}.`}>
              {Array.from({ length: 5 }, (_, tick) => tick * COMPANY_TARGET.axisMax / 4).map(value => <g key={value}><line className="crm-minimal__gridline" x1={100 + value / COMPANY_TARGET.axisMax * 500} x2={100 + value / COMPANY_TARGET.axisMax * 500} y1="30" y2="120" /><text className="crm-minimal__svg-label" x={100 + value / COMPANY_TARGET.axisMax * 500} y="140" textAnchor="middle">{value}</text></g>)}
              <text className="crm-minimal__svg-label" x="88" y="79" textAnchor="end">All branches</text>
              <rect className="crm-minimal__target-track" x="100" y="40" width="500" height="70" />
              <Tooltip as="g" content={`All branches: ${COMPANY_TARGET.achieved.toLocaleString('en-US')} shipments · Target: ${COMPANY_TARGET.target}`} placement="bottom"><rect {...drilldownProps({ kind: 'shipments', label: 'All branches', value: COMPANY_TARGET.achieved })} aria-label={`Achieved: ${COMPANY_TARGET.achieved} shipments. Target: ${COMPANY_TARGET.target}`} className="crm-minimal__target-fill crm-minimal__chart-hit" x="100" y="49" width={COMPANY_TARGET.achieved / COMPANY_TARGET.axisMax * 500} height="52" /></Tooltip>
              <line className="crm-minimal__target-marker" x1={100 + COMPANY_TARGET.target / COMPANY_TARGET.axisMax * 500} x2={100 + COMPANY_TARGET.target / COMPANY_TARGET.axisMax * 500} y1="40" y2="110" />
              <text className="crm-minimal__svg-value" x={100 + COMPANY_TARGET.achieved / COMPANY_TARGET.axisMax * 250} y="80" textAnchor="middle">{COMPANY_TARGET.achieved}</text>
              <text className="crm-minimal__svg-label" x="350" y="170" textAnchor="middle">Shipment Count</text>
            </svg>
            <div className="crm-minimal__target-legend"><span aria-hidden="true" />Achieved</div>
          </>}
        </section>
        <section className="crm-minimal__chart" aria-labelledby={`${id}-appointments-title`}>
          <div className="crm-minimal__section-heading"><h2 id={`${id}-appointments-title`}>My Today's Appointments</h2></div>
          {empty ? <p className="crm-minimal__empty">No appointments scheduled today.</p> : <ul className="crm-minimal__list crm-minimal__appointment-agenda">{TODAYS_APPOINTMENTS.map(appointment => <li key={appointment.id}>
            <img className="crm-minimal__appointment-avatar" src={`${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}images/avatars/${appointment.avatar}`} alt={appointment.contact} width="40" height="40" />
            <div className="crm-minimal__appointment-agenda-details">
              <h3>{appointment.title}</h3>
              <p className="crm-minimal__appointment-time"><span>{appointment.account} · {appointment.contact}</span><span><time dateTime={appointment.time}>{appointment.time}</time> · {appointment.type}</span></p>
            </div>
            <div className="crm-minimal__appointment-actions" role="group" aria-label={`Actions for ${appointment.title}`}>
              <Button variant="link-primary" onClick={() => setSelectedAppointment(appointment)}>View details</Button>
              <Button variant="default" size="sm" aria-pressed={completedAppointments.includes(appointment.id)} onClick={() => setCompletedAppointments(current => current.includes(appointment.id) ? current.filter(item => item !== appointment.id) : [...current, appointment.id])}>{completedAppointments.includes(appointment.id) ? 'Completed' : 'Mark done'}</Button>
            </div>
          </li>)}</ul>}
          <Modal isOpen={selectedAppointment !== null} type="alert" variant="info" title={selectedAppointment?.title ?? 'Appointment details'} description={selectedAppointment ? `${selectedAppointment.account} · ${selectedAppointment.contact} · ${selectedAppointment.time}–${selectedAppointment.end} · ${selectedAppointment.type}` : ''} confirmLabel="Close" onClose={() => setSelectedAppointment(null)} />
        </section>
      </div>
      <div className="crm-minimal__industry-builder" style={{ order: sections.indexOf('industry') + 1 }} data-dashboard-section="industry">
      <section className="crm-minimal__chart crm-minimal__industries" aria-labelledby={`${id}-industries-title`}>
        <div className="crm-minimal__section-heading"><h2 id={`${id}-industries-title`}>Accounts by Industry</h2></div>
        {empty ? <p className="crm-minimal__empty">Add accounts to see your industry breakdown.</p> : <div className="crm-minimal__industry-scroll" tabIndex={0} role="group" aria-label="Industry chart, scroll horizontally on small screens">
          <svg ref={industryRef} className="crm-minimal__columns" viewBox={`0 0 ${industryWidth} 300`} role="img" aria-label={`Accounts by Industry. ${ACCOUNTS_BY_INDUSTRY.map(item => `${item.industry}: ${item.count}`).join('; ')}. Total: ${ACCOUNTS_BY_INDUSTRY.reduce((total, item) => total + item.count, 0)} accounts.`}>
            {Array.from({ length: 5 }, (_, tick) => tick * industryMax / 4).map(value => <g key={value}><line className="crm-minimal__gridline" x1="50" x2={industryWidth - 10} y1={240 - value / industryMax * 208} y2={240 - value / industryMax * 208} /><text className="crm-minimal__svg-label" x="38" y={245 - value / industryMax * 208} textAnchor="end">{value}</text></g>)}
            {ACCOUNTS_BY_INDUSTRY.map((item, index) => <g key={item.industry}>
              <Tooltip as="g" content={`${item.industry}: ${item.count} accounts`} placement="bottom"><rect {...drilldownProps({ kind: 'industry', label: item.industry, value: item.count })} aria-label={`${item.industry}: ${item.count} accounts`} data-industry={item.industry} className="crm-minimal__column crm-minimal__chart-hit" x={50 + index * industryStep + industryStep * 0.23} y={240 - item.count / industryMax * 208} width={industryStep * 0.54} height={item.count / industryMax * 208} /></Tooltip>
              <text className="crm-minimal__svg-value" x={50 + (index + 0.5) * industryStep} y={230 - item.count / industryMax * 208} textAnchor="middle">{item.count}</text>
              <foreignObject x={50 + index * industryStep + 2.5} y="250" width={industryStep - 5} height="50">
                <div className="crm-minimal__industry-label">{item.industry}</div>
              </foreignObject>
            </g>)}
          </svg>
        </div>}
      </section>
      <section className="crm-minimal__builder" aria-labelledby={`${id}-builder-title`}>
        <div className="crm-minimal__builder-intro">
          <span className="crm-minimal__builder-mark"><Icon name="WmsZia" size={24} /></span>
          <h2 id={`${id}-builder-title`}>Plan <span>Your Next Shipment.</span></h2>
          <p>How can we help your cargo move today?</p>
        </div>
        <form className="crm-minimal__builder-form" onSubmit={event => { event.preventDefault(); if (builderPrompt.trim()) { setBuilderDiscuss(false); setBuilderPreview(builderPrompt.trim()); } }}>
          <span className="crm-minimal__builder-sparkle" aria-hidden="true" />
          <div ref={builderInput}><Textarea aria-label="Describe your shipment plan" placeholder="Ask about freight quotes, trade lanes, or shipment plans…" width="100%" layout="vertical" minHeight={48} value={builderPrompt} maxLength={2000} onChange={(event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => setBuilderPrompt(event.target.value)} /></div>
          <div className="crm-minimal__builder-toolbar">
            <div className="crm-minimal__builder-tools" role="group" aria-label="Shipment planning tools">
              <Button type="button" variant="link-default" disabled aria-label="Attach file (unavailable in local demo)" title="Attachments are unavailable in this local demo"><Icon name="RtUnlink" size={18} /></Button>
              <Button type="button" variant="link-default" aria-label="Edit shipment plan" title="Edit shipment plan" onClick={() => builderInput.current?.querySelector('textarea')?.focus()}><Icon name="Edit" size={18} /></Button>
            </div>
            <div className="crm-minimal__builder-tools" role="group" aria-label="Preview controls">
              <Button type="button" variant="link-default" disabled aria-label="Voice input (unavailable in local demo)" title="Voice input is unavailable in this local demo"><Icon name="WmsAnnouncements" size={20} /></Button>
              <div className="crm-minimal__builder-send-group">
                <div className="crm-minimal__builder-send-extras">
                  <Button type="button" variant="link-default" aria-label="Discuss shipment plan first" title="Let's discuss first · Local demo" disabled={!builderPrompt.trim()} onClick={() => { setBuilderDiscuss(true); setBuilderPreview(builderPrompt.trim()); }}><Icon name="WmsChat" size={16} /></Button>
                </div>
                <span className="crm-minimal__builder-send"><Button type="submit" size="sm" aria-label="Preview shipment plan" title="Preview shipment plan · Local demo" disabled={!builderPrompt.trim()}>
                  <svg viewBox="0 0 26 26" width="26" height="26" fill="none" aria-hidden="true">
                    <rect width="26" height="26" rx="13" fill="var(--crm-minimal-accent)" />
                    <path d="M9.5 11.69L13 8.19L16.5 11.69M13 8.19V17.81" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
                  </svg>
                </Button></span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </form>
        {builderPreview !== null && <Modal isOpen type="alert" variant="info" title={builderDiscuss ? 'Discuss shipment plan · Local demo' : 'Shipment plan preview · Local demo'} description={`${builderPreview}\n\n${builderDiscuss ? 'Consider the intended users, required data, and desired outcome before building. ' : ''}This preview only captures your shipment plan. No bookings are created and no data is sent.`} confirmLabel="Back to shipment plan" onSave={() => { setBuilderPreview(null); builderInput.current?.querySelector('textarea')?.focus(); }} onClose={() => { setBuilderPreview(null); builderInput.current?.querySelector('textarea')?.focus(); }} />}
      </section>
      </div>
      <div className="crm-minimal__grid" style={{ order: sections.indexOf('work') + 1 }} data-dashboard-section="work">
        <section id={`${id}-deals`} aria-labelledby={`${id}-deals-title`} className="crm-minimal__deals">
          <div className="crm-minimal__section-heading"><h2 id={`${id}-deals-title`}>Open deals</h2></div>
          <div className="crm-minimal__table"><SetupTable columns={COLUMNS} rows={rows} selectable={false} width="100%" maxHeight="var(--crm-minimal-list-height)" emptyMessage="No open deals yet. Your opportunities will appear here." /></div>
        </section>
        <aside className="crm-minimal__daily" aria-label="Daily workspace">
          <section id={`${id}-today`} aria-labelledby={`${id}-tasks-title`}>
            <div className="crm-minimal__section-heading"><h2 id={`${id}-tasks-title`}>Today and OverDue Tasks</h2></div>
            <ul className="crm-minimal__list crm-minimal__today-list" tabIndex={tasks.length ? 0 : undefined} aria-label="Today's tasks">{tasks.map(task => <li key={task.id} data-completed={task.completed || undefined}><Checkbox label={task.title} checked={task.completed} onChange={() => setTasks(current => current.map(item => item.id === task.id ? { ...item, completed: !item.completed } : item))} /></li>)}</ul>
            {empty && <p className="crm-minimal__empty" role="status">Nothing scheduled. Enjoy a fresh start.</p>}
          </section>
        </aside>
      </div>
    </div>
    {drilldown && <MinimalDrilldown selection={drilldown} view={homeView} onClose={() => setDrilldown(null)} />}
  </div></CrmHomepage>;
}

export const Default: Story = { render: () => <MinimalPage /> };

export const FormationChecks: Story = {
  tags: ['!dev', '!autodocs'],
  render: () => <MinimalPage />,
  play: async ({ canvasElement }) => {
    const canvas = within(canvasElement);
    const page = canvasElement.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.crm-minimal')!;
    const animations = () => page.getAnimations({ subtree: true }).filter(animation => animation.id === 'crm-minimal-formation');
    await userEvent.click(canvas.getByRole('button', { name: 'Classic Sales View' }));
    await userEvent.click(within(canvasElement.ownerDocument.body).getByRole('option', { name: 'Freight Pipeline Center' }));
    if (window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
      await expect(animations()).toHaveLength(0);
      return;
    }
    await waitFor(() => expect(animations().length).toBeGreaterThan(10));
    const revenue = page.querySelector<SVGSVGElement>('.crm-minimal__line')!;
    const height = revenue.getBoundingClientRect().height;
    animations().forEach(animation => animation.finish());
    await expect(revenue.getBoundingClientRect().height).toBe(height);
    await expect(page.querySelectorAll('[data-revenue-series]')).toHaveLength(2);
    const industry = page.querySelector<SVGRectElement>('[data-industry]')!;
    await expect(industry.getBoundingClientRect().height).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    const legend = within(canvas.getByRole('list', { name: 'Revenue series' }));
    await userEvent.click(legend.getByRole('button', { name: 'Forecast' }));
    await expect(page.querySelector('[data-revenue-series="Forecast"]')).toBeNull();
    await expect(animations()).toHaveLength(0);
    await userEvent.click(legend.getByRole('button', { name: 'Forecast' }));
    await expect(page.querySelectorAll('[data-revenue-series]')).toHaveLength(2);
    await expect(animations()).toHaveLength(0);
  },
};

export const InteractionChecks: Story = {
  tags: ['!dev', '!autodocs'],
  render: () => <MinimalPage />,
  play: async ({ canvasElement }) => {
    const canvas = within(canvasElement);
    await expect(canvas.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Welcome Patricia Boyle' })).toBeVisible();
    const builder = within(canvas.getByRole('region', { name: 'Plan Your Next Shipment.' }));
    await expect(builder.queryByRole('heading', { name: 'Suggestions' })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    await expect(builder.queryByRole('list')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    const prompt = builder.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Describe your shipment plan' });
    await expect(builder.getByRole('button', { name: 'Attach file (unavailable in local demo)' })).toBeDisabled();
    await expect(builder.getByRole('button', { name: 'Voice input (unavailable in local demo)' })).toBeDisabled();
    await userEvent.click(builder.getByRole('button', { name: 'Edit shipment plan' }));
    await expect(prompt).toHaveFocus();
    await expect(builder.getByRole('button', { name: 'Preview shipment plan' })).toBeDisabled();
    await userEvent.type(prompt, 'Plan weekly ocean freight capacity for Singapore to Rotterdam.');
    await userEvent.click(builder.getByRole('button', { name: 'Preview shipment plan' }));
    const preview = within(canvasElement.ownerDocument.body).getByRole('alertdialog', { name: 'Shipment plan preview · Local demo' });
    await expect(preview).toHaveTextContent('No bookings are created');
    await userEvent.click(within(preview).getByRole('button', { name: 'Back to shipment plan' }));
    await expect(prompt).toHaveValue('Plan weekly ocean freight capacity for Singapore to Rotterdam.');
    builder.getByRole('button', { name: 'Preview shipment plan' }).focus();
    await userEvent.click(await builder.findByRole('button', { name: 'Discuss shipment plan first' }));
    const discussion = within(canvasElement.ownerDocument.body).getByRole('alertdialog', { name: 'Discuss shipment plan · Local demo' });
    await expect(discussion).toHaveTextContent('Consider the intended users');
    await userEvent.click(within(discussion).getByRole('button', { name: 'Back to shipment plan' }));
    await expect(prompt).toHaveFocus();
    await userEvent.clear(prompt);
    await expect(builder.getByRole('button', { name: 'Preview shipment plan' })).toBeDisabled();
    (prompt as HTMLTextAreaElement).blur();
    await expect(canvas.queryByText('Friday, June 19, 2026')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    await expect(canvas.queryByText('A little clarity for your next move.')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    await expect(canvas.queryByText('Reporting period')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    await expect(canvas.queryByRole('button', { name: 'All Territories' })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    const overview = within(canvas.getByRole('region', { name: 'Sales overview' }));
    await expect(overview.getAllByRole('term')).toHaveLength(4);
    await expect(canvas.queryByText('Revenue goal')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    const miniArea = overview.getByRole('img', { name: 'Open pipeline sample trend across 15 snapshots' });
    await expect(miniArea).toBeVisible();
    await expect(miniArea.querySelectorAll('path')).toHaveLength(2);
    await expect(canvasElement.ownerDocument.defaultView!.getComputedStyle(miniArea).position).toBe('absolute');
    await expect(overview.getByText('Conversion rate')).toBeVisible();
    const miniColumns = overview.getByRole('img', { name: 'Conversion rate sample trend across 45 snapshots' });
    await expect(miniColumns).toBeVisible();
    await expect(miniColumns.querySelectorAll('rect')).toHaveLength(45);
    await expect(canvasElement.ownerDocument.defaultView!.getComputedStyle(miniColumns).position).toBe('absolute');
    const conversionBar = miniColumns.querySelector<SVGRectElement>('rect')!;
    const conversionBounds = miniColumns.getBoundingClientRect();
    await userEvent.pointer({ target: conversionBar, coords: { clientX: conversionBounds.left + conversionBounds.width / (CONVERSION_SNAPSHOTS.length * 2), clientY: conversionBounds.bottom - 2 } });
    const conversionTooltip = within(canvasElement.ownerDocument.body).getByRole('tooltip');
    await expect(conversionTooltip).toHaveTextContent('Snapshot 1: 18% conversion');
    const conversionSurface = miniColumns.querySelector<SVGPathElement>('path')!;
    for (const position of [0.03, 0.05, 0.5, 0.99]) {
      await userEvent.pointer({ target: conversionSurface, coords: { clientX: conversionBounds.left + conversionBounds.width * position, clientY: conversionBounds.top + 1 } });
      await expect(within(canvasElement.ownerDocument.body).getByRole('tooltip')).toBe(conversionTooltip);
      const snapshot = Math.floor(position * CONVERSION_SNAPSHOTS.length);
      await expect(conversionTooltip).toHaveTextContent(`Snapshot ${snapshot + 1}: ${CONVERSION_SNAPSHOTS[snapshot]}% conversion`);
    }
    await userEvent.unhover(conversionSurface);
    await expect(within(canvasElement.ownerDocument.body).queryByRole('tooltip')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    await expect(overview.getByText('25%', { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
    await expect(overview.getByText('$84,500')).toBeVisible();
    const trend = within(canvas.getByRole('region', { name: 'Revenue trend' }));
    const revenueChart = trend.getByRole('img', { name: /Revenue trend/ });
    await expect(revenueChart).toBeVisible();
    await expect(revenueChart.querySelectorAll('path')).toHaveLength(4);
    const styles = canvasElement.ownerDocument.defaultView!;
    const blueSeries = revenueChart.querySelector<SVGGElement>('.crm-minimal__revenue--blue')!;
    const forecastSeries = revenueChart.querySelector<SVGGElement>('.crm-minimal__revenue--pink')!;
    await expect(styles.getComputedStyle(miniColumns).color).not.toBe(styles.getComputedStyle(blueSeries).color);
    await expect(styles.getComputedStyle(forecastSeries).color).not.toBe(styles.getComputedStyle(blueSeries).color);

export const RevenueLegend: Story = {
  render: () => <MinimalPage />,
  play: async ({ canvasElement }) => {
    const legend = within(within(canvasElement).getByRole('list', { name: 'Revenue series' }));
    const closed = legend.getByRole('button', { name: 'Closed revenue' });
    const forecast = legend.getByRole('button', { name: 'Forecast' });
    const series = () => canvasElement.querySelectorAll('[data-revenue-series]');
    await expect(series()).toHaveLength(2);
    await userEvent.click(closed);
    await expect(closed).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
    await expect(closed).toHaveStyle({ opacity: '0.4' });
    await expect(series()).toHaveLength(1);
    await expect(series()[0]).toHaveAttribute('data-revenue-series', 'Forecast');
    await userEvent.click(forecast);
    await expect(series()).toHaveLength(0);
    closed.focus();
    await userEvent.keyboard('{Enter}');
    await expect(closed).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
    await expect(series()).toHaveLength(1);
    forecast.focus();
    await userEvent.keyboard(' ');
    await expect(forecast).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
    await expect(series()).toHaveLength(2);
  },
};

export const ChartDrilldown: Story = {
  tags: ['test-only'],
  render: () => <MinimalPage />,
  play: async ({ canvasElement }) => {
    const body = within(canvasElement.ownerDocument.body);
    const page = canvasElement.querySelector('.crm-minimal')!;
    const marks = [
      ['[data-revenue-series="Closed revenue"] circle', 'Revenue trend'],
      ['[data-revenue-series="Forecast"] circle', 'Revenue trend'],
      ['.crm-minimal__donut .crm-minimal__chart-hit', 'Pipeline by stage'],
      ['[data-industry="Electronics"]', 'Accounts by Industry'],
      ['.crm-minimal__target-fill', 'Company Target'],
      ['[data-snapshot="0"]', 'Pipeline by stage'],
      ['.crm-minimal__kpi-columns rect', 'Conversion rate'],
    ];
    for (const [selector, title] of marks) {
      const mark = page.querySelector<SVGElement>(selector)!;
      mark.focus();
      await userEvent.keyboard('{Enter}');
      const dialog = await body.findByRole('dialog', { name: title });
      await waitFor(() => expect(within(dialog).getByRole('heading', { name: 'Drilled Down By' })).toBeVisible());
      await expect(within(dialog).getByRole('region', { name: 'Chart records' })).toBeVisible();
      await userEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole('button', { name: 'Close chart records' }));
      await waitFor(() => expect(body.queryByRole('dialog')).not.toBeInTheDocument());
      await expect(mark).toHaveFocus();
    }
  },
};

import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react-vite';
import { expect, userEvent, waitFor, within } from 'storybook/test';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { MinimalDrilldown } from './MinimalDrilldown';
import { getDrilldownData } from './Minimal.drilldown';
import type { DrilldownSelection } from './Minimal.drilldown';

const meta = { title: 'Design System/Patterns/crm-homepage/minimal-drilldown', parameters: { layout: 'fullscreen' } } satisfies Meta;
export default meta;
type Story = StoryObj<typeof meta>;
function Preview({ selection }: { selection: DrilldownSelection }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(true);
  return <><button type="button" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>Open chart records</button>{open && <MinimalDrilldown selection={selection} view="classic" onClose={() => setOpen(false)} />}</>;
}

    await expect(within(dialog).getByRole('columnheader', { name: 'Account Name' })).toBeVisible();
    const close = within(dialog).getByRole('button', { name: 'Close chart records' });
    await expect(close.parentElement?.firstElementChild).toBe(close);
    await expect(getComputedStyle(close).borderRadius).toBe('50%');
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(close.getBoundingClientRect().right).toBeLessThan(dialog.getBoundingClientRect().left);
      expect(close.getBoundingClientRect().left).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
    });
    await expect(getComputedStyle(dialog).overflow).toBe('visible');
    const table = within(dialog).getByRole('region', { name: 'Chart records' });
    await expect(table.getBoundingClientRect().right).toBeLessThan(dialog.getBoundingClientRect().right - 15);
    for (const cell of dialog.querySelectorAll('tbody td')) {
      await expect(getComputedStyle(cell).whiteSpace).toBe('nowrap');
      await expect(cell.querySelector('small')).toBeNull();
    }
    await expect(within(dialog).getByRole('link', { name: 'Open records in new tab' }).querySelector('svg')).not.toBeNull();
    const sample = getDrilldownData({ kind: 'revenue', label: 'February', series: 'Closed revenue', value: 105 });
    await expect(sample.records.reduce((sum, record) => sum + Math.round(record.amount * 100), 0)).toBe(10500000);
    await expect(sample.records.every(record => record.date.startsWith('2026-02') && record.category === 'Closed won')).toBe(true);
    for (const format of ['Excel', 'CSV']) {
      await userEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole('button', { name: 'Export As' }));
      const option = await body.findByRole('option', { name: format });
      await userEvent.click(option);
      await expect(within(dialog).getByRole('status')).toHaveTextContent(`Exported ${sample.records.length} records as ${format}.`);
      await expect(within(dialog).getByRole('button', { name: 'Export As' })).toBeVisible();
    }
    await userEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole('button', { name: 'Close chart records' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(body.queryByRole('dialog')).not.toBeInTheDocument());
  },
};

    await expect(JSON.parse(url.searchParams.get('chart-records')!).label).toBe('Electronics');
    await expect(url.searchParams.get('home-view')).toBe('classic');
    await userEvent.keyboard('{Escape}');

  },
};

function WizardFooter({ onPrev, onNext, onCancel, nextLabel = 'Next', prevLabel = 'Previous', showCancel = false }) {
